en: - क्रमणे — क्रमु पादविक्षेपे धातुः । भावार्थे ल्युट् प्रत्ययः । युवोरनाकौ इति तस्य अनादेशः । अट्‌कुप्वाज् इति सूत्रेण नकारस्य णत्वं । लिति (पा. सू. ६-१-१९३) इति प्रत्ययात् पूर्वमुदात्तस्वरो भवति ।
- स्वर्दृशः — दृशिर् प्रेक्षणे धातुः । क्विप् प्रत्ययः । गतिकारकोपपदात् कृत् इति कृदुत्तरपदप्रकृतिस्वरो भवति । षष्ठीएकवचनांतरूपं ।
- अभिख्याय — ख्या प्रकथने धातुः । तस्मात् क्त्वा प्रत्यये समासेन नञ्पूर्वे (पा. सू. ७-१-७२) इति तस्य ल्यबादेशः । पित्त्वात् सोऽनुदात्तो भवति । ⟨NOTE:425⟩
- भुरण्यति — भुरण्य गत् धातुः । कंड्वादिः । भुरण्यति शवति (निरु. १४-१६) इति गतिकर्मकधातूनां मध्ये पठितः । लट् प्रथमपुरुषएकवचनांतरूपं । अतिजंतस्य परत्वात् निघातस्वरो भवति ।

- दधर्षति — धृषि शसी वैयात्ये धातुः । इध्यषा प्रागल्भ्ये धातुः । लट् प्रथमपुरुषएकवचने तिप् प्रत्ययः । बहुलं छंदसि इति शपः श्लु आदेशः । लेटोऽडाट् (पा. सू. ३-४-९४) इति प्रत्ययस्य अडागमः । धातोर्द्वित्वादि । प्रत्ययनिमित्तत्वेन धातोर्लघोपधाया गुणः । अतिजंतस्य परत्वात् निघातस्वरो भवति ।
- वयः — वा गतिगंधनयोः धातुः । वातेर्डिच्च (उ. सू. ४-५७३) इति इण् प्रत्ययः । तस्य डित्त्वविधानात् धातोः टेः (आ) लोपः । वि शब्दो भवति । प्रथमाबहुवचनांतरूपं ।

- पतयंतः — पत्ल्य गतौ धातुः । अस्मात् ण्यंतात् शतृप्रत्ययः । शप् विकरणः । णिचि निमित्ते धातोरकारस्य लोपः । तस्य स्थानिवद्भावात् उपधावृद्धिर्न भवति । शप् निमित्ते णिचो गुणः । अयादेशः । तास्यनुदात्तेत् इति सूत्रेण लसार्वधातुकस्यानुदात्तत्वात् णिच्स्वरः अवशिष्यते ।

- पतत्रिणः — पत्ल्य गतौ धातुः । अमिनक्षियजि (उ. सू. ३-३८५) इत्यस्मात् अत्रन् प्रत्ययः । पतत्रं अस्य अस्ति इति पतत्री । अत इनिठनौ इति मत्वर्थे इनिप्रत्ययः । प्रत्ययस्याद्युदात्तस्वरो भवति । प्रथमाबहुवचनांतरूपं । (Ṛk 5 ends.)

en: This Viṣṇu, whose nature is the Āditya, together with four and ninety, that is, ninety-four, (in all) — these are the parts of time of that number. By his "names", that is, his own modes of inclining or movement, his special impulsions, he sets them in motion so that they are rounded: व्यतीन् (*vyatīn*), of varied extension. As one whirls a wheel, a round wheel with many spokes, by throwing it above the enemy, so he makes the said parts of time whirl; अवीविपत् (*avīvipat*) means "makes tremble, makes revolve" (root टुवेपृ (*ṭuvepṛ*), to tremble; from the causal, the form is with luk and cajji). Which are they? One year; two solstices; five seasons; twelve months; twenty-four half-months; thirty days-and-nights; eight watches; and, in one day, the twelve signs beginning with Meṣa that revolve (and are attached). Taken together these are ninety-four, which he whirls. (The bhāṣya continues on the next page.)

Objection: the Āditya himself revolves like the others, so how can he be said to make them revolve? Answer: there is no fault, because the fixed Viṣṇu who sets them revolving is another form of Viṣṇu; or else, because the revolution of the others depends on his own revolution, he is said to make them revolve himself. So Viṣṇu, whose nature is time, is vast of body, because the bodies of all gods, men and the rest are his own body in the form of the Virāṭ. He justifies this "vast body": विमिमानः (*vimimānaḥ*), measuring himself in diverse ways, establishing himself by dividing into the forms of gods, beasts and others. Or else: he is "measured out" by ऋक्वभिः (*ṛkvabhiḥ*), by the praising or the mantra-possessing; though all-pervading, he is dependent on his devotees and is measured by praise. युवा (*yuvā*): mingling everywhere, or ever young; therefore अकुमारः (*akumāraḥ*), not small. Such a Mahāviṣṇu goes to the invocation (āhava), that is, to the place of sacrifice.

kn: ಚ—ತೊಂಭತ್ತುನಾಲ್ಕು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳುಳ್ಳವೂ । ವ್ಯತೀನ್—ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆಯಾಗಿ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳಾಗಿರುವುವೂ ಆದ ಕಾಲದ
ಅವಯವಗಳನ್ನು । ಚಕ್ರಂ ನ—ಅರಗಳ ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಸುತ್ತುವ ಚಕ್ರದಂತೆ । ವೃತ್ತಂ—ವಲಯಾಕಾರವಾಗಿ ಸುತ್ತು
ಋಕ್ವಭಿಃ—ಮಂತ್ರರೂಪವಾದ ಸ್ತುತಿಗಳಿಂದ । ವಿಮಿಮಾನಃ—(ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು) ದೇವತಿರ್ಯಗಾದಿ ನಾನಾ
ರೂಪಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಾಗಿಸಿ ಪರಿಣಮಿಸುವವನೂ । ಯುವಾ—ಸರ್ವತ್ರ ಸೇರಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವವನೂ ಅಥವಾ ನಿತ್ಯತರುಣನೂ ।
ಅಕುಮಾರಃ—(ಆದರೆ) ಶಿಶುರೂಪನಲ್ಲದವನೂ ಆದ ಮಹಾವಿಷ್ಣುವು । ಆಹವಂ—ನಮ್ಮ ಆಹ್ವಾನವನ್ನು ಲಕ್ಷಿಸಿ ।
en: - नामभिः (*nāmabhiḥ*)—by his modes of revolving (the Viṣṇu who is the Āditya)
- चतुर्भिस्साकं नवतिं च (*caturbhissākaṃ navatiṃ ca*)—ninety-four in number
- व्यतीन् (*vyatīn*)—the parts of time that stand divided separately
- चक्रं न (*cakraṃ na*)—like a wheel revolving about its spokes
- वृत्तं (*vṛttaṃ*)—as if turning in a circle
- बृहच्छरीरः (*bṛhaccharīraḥ*)—he who has the body of the Virāṭ
- ऋक्वभिः (*ṛkvabhiḥ*)—by praises in the form of mantras
- विमिमानः (*vimimānaḥ*)—he who divides (his own nature) into diverse forms such as gods and beasts and evolves
- युवा (*yuvā*)—he who joins everywhere, or the ever young
- अकुमारः (*akumāraḥ*)—(yet) one who is not of infant form, Mahāviṣṇu

kn: ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವು ತನ್ನ ಭ್ರಮಣಪ್ರಕಾರಗಳಿಂದ ತೊಂಭತ್ತುನಾಲ್ಕು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳುಳ್ಳವೂ, ಬೇರೆ
ಬೇರೆಯಾಗಿ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳಾಗಿರುವುವೂ ಆದ ಸಂವತ್ಸರಾದಿಕಾಲದ ಅವಯವಗಳನ್ನು ಅರಗಳ ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಸುತ್ತುವ
ಚಕ್ರದಂತೆ ವಲಯಾಕಾರವಾಗಿ ಸುತ್ತುವಂತೆ ಭ್ರಮಣಮಾಡಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವಿರಾಡ್ರೂಪದ ಶರೀರವುಳ್ಳವನೂ, ಮಂತ್ರ
ರೂಪವಾದ ಸ್ತುತಿಗಳಿಂದ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು ದೇವತಿರಗಾದಿನಾನಾರೂಪಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಾಗಿಸಿ ಪರಿಣಮಿಸುವವನೂ,
ನಿತ್ಯತರುಣನೂ ಆದರೆ ಶಿಶುರೂಪನಲ್ಲದವನೂ ಆದ ಮಹಾವಿಷ್ಣುವು ನಮ್ಮ ಆಹ್ವಾನವನ್ನು ಲಕ್ಷಿಸಿ ಯಜ್ಞಭೂಮಿಗೆ
en: Viṣṇu, whose nature is the Āditya, by his modes of revolution makes the parts of time, year and the rest, ninety-four in number and divided separately, revolve in a circle like a wheel turning round its spokes. He who has the body of the Virāṭ, who by praises in mantra-form divides his own nature into the diverse forms of gods, beasts and others and evolves, who is ever young yet not of infant form, Mahāviṣṇu, comes to the sacrificial ground regarding our invocation.

kn: He causes, by his gyrations, ninety and four periodical revolutions, like a circular wheel, vast of body, and evolving in many forms, through the praises (addressed to him); ever young, though not infantine, he comes at our invocations,

kn: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ಮಹಿಮೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ತುತಿಸಿದೆ. ನಿರುಕ್ತಕಾರರು ಸ್ವಸರಾಣಿ ಎಂಬ ಪದದ
ಅಹಸ್ಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಚಲಿಸುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಆದಿತ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಸ್ವಃ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ
ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ಭ್ರಮಣರೂಪವಾದ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನೂ ಕಾಲಾದಿ ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳನ್ನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಚಲಿಸುವಂತೆ
ಚತುರ್ಭಿಸ್ಸಾಕಂ ನವತಿಂ ಚ—ಏತತ್ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಕಾನ್ ಕಾಲಾವಯವಾನ್ । ಎಂದು ಕಾಲದ ಅವಯನ
ಗಳನ್ನು ತೊಂಭತ್ತುನಾಲ್ಕು ಭಾಗಗಳನ್ನಾಗಿ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿದೆ. ಅವು ಯಾವವೆಂದರೆ—
ಈ ರೀತಿ ಕಾಲದ ಅವಯವಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟು ತೊಂಭತ್ತು ನಾಲ್ಕು.
ವ್ಯತೀನ್—ವಿವಿಧಾತನಸ್ವಭಾವಾನ್। ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ರೂಪಗಳಿಂದಿರುವ ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾಲಾವಯವಗಳನ್ನೂ
ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಆಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಅವಕಾಶವಿದೆಯೆಂದು ಭಾಷ್ಯಕಾರರು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕ ಸಮಾ
ನನ್ವಾದಿತ್ಯಃ ಸ್ವಯಮಪಿ ಇತರವತ್ಪರಿಭ್ರಮತಿ ಕಥಂ ಭ್ರಮಯತಿ ಇತ್ಯುಚ್ಯತೇ । ನೈಷ ದೋಷಃ।
ಏತೇಷಾಂ ಭ್ರಾಮಕಸ್ಯ ಧ್ರುವಸ್ಯ ವಿಷ್ಣೋಃ ಮೂರ್ತ್ಯಂತರತ್ವಾತ್ । ಅಥವಾ ಸ್ವಭ್ರಮಣಾಧೀನತ್ವಾದಿತರೇಷಾಂ ಪರಿಭ್ರಮಣಸ್ಯ ಅತಃ ಸ್ವಯಂ ಭ್ರಮಯತಿ ಇತ್ಯುಚ್ಯತೇ ॥
ಆದಿತ್ಯನೂ ಕೂಡ ಇತರ ಗ್ರಹಾದಿಗಳಂತೆ ಭ್ರಮಣಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು ತಾನೇ ಹೊಂದಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಇತರ
ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಅವನು ಚಲಿಸುವಂತೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಮಾಡಬಲ್ಲನು ಎಂದು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯನ್ನು ಆಶಂಕಿಸಿ, ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿರತಕ್ಕ ಇತರ
ಸಕಲ ವಸ್ತುಗಳೂ ಸಹ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ರೂಪಾಂತರಗಳೇ ಆಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದಲೂ, ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಚಲನವಲನಗಳೆಲ್ಲಾ
ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ಭ್ರಮಣವನ್ನೇ ಆಶ್ರಯಿಸಿರುವುದರಿಂದಲೂ ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸ್ವಾಭಾವಿಕವಾದ ವರ್ಣನೆ
ಈ ಆಕ್ಷೇಪಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾಧಾನವನ್ನು ಹೇಳುವುದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಯಣರು ಕಾಲಾತ್ಮಕವಾದ ವಿಶ್ವತತ್ತ್ವವನ್ನು
ಸಂಗ್ರಹರೂಪವಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಕಾಲಾತ್ಮಕಃ ವಿಷ್ಣುಃ ಎನ್ನುವುದರಿಂದಲೂ, ವಿರಾಡಾತ್ಮನಾ ಸರ್ವದೇವಮನುಷ್ಯಾದಿಶರೀರಾಣಾಂ ಸ್ವಶರೀರತ್ವಾತ್ ಎನ್ನುವುದರಿಂದಲೂ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿಗೂ ವಿಶ್ವಕ್ಕೂ ತಾದಾತ್ಮವನ್ನು
ಹೇಳಿ ವಿಶ್ವದ ವ್ಯವಹಾರವೆಲ್ಲವೂ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರವನ್ನವಲಂಬಿಸಿದೆಯೆಂದು ಹೇಳಿದೆ. ವಿಮಿಮಾನಃ ಎಂಬ
ವಿಶೇಷಣದಿಂದ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸ್ಥಿತ್ಯಾದಿಗಳಿಗೂ ಸಹ (ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಯೆಂದು ಬೇರೆ ರೂಪದಿಂದ ವರ್ಣಿಸಲ್ಪಡುವ) ವಿಷ್ಣುವೇ
ಹೇತುವೆಂದೂ ಹೇಳಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ಚತುರಧಿಕನವತಿ (೯೪) ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಕವಾದುದೂ ಚಕ್ರ
ರೂಪವಾದುದೂ ಆದ ಕಾಲಾವಯವಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದೊಂದು ಕಡೆ ಒಂದೊಂದು ವಿಧವಾಗಿ ವರ್ಣಿಸಿ ವಿಶ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಹೇತು
ವಾದ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಯ ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳೇ ಇವು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಿದೆ.
ದ್ವಾದಶಾರಂ ನಹಿ ತಜ್ಞರಾಯ ವರ್ವರ್ತಿ ಚಕ್ರಂ ಪರಿ ದ್ಯಾಮೃತಸ್ಯ ।
ಆ ಪುತ್ರಾ ಅಗ್ನೇ ಮಿಥುನಾಸೋ ಅತ್ರ ಸಪ್ತ ಶತಾನಿ ವಿಂಶತಿಶ್ಚ ತಸ್ಥುಃ ।
ಸತ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕಸ್ಯಾದಿತ್ಯಸ್ಯ ಚಕ್ರಂ ಪುನಃಪುನಃ ಕ್ರಮಣಶೀಲಂ ಮಂಡಲಾಖ್ಯಂ ರಥಚಕ್ರಂ ವಾ ವರ್ವತಿ ।
ಪಂಚಪಾದಂ ಪಿತರಂ ದ್ವಾದಶಾಕೃತಿಂ ದಿವ ಆಹುಃ ಪರೇ ಅರ್ಧೇ ಪುರೀಷಿಣಂ ।
ಅಥೇಮೇ ಅನ್ಯ ಉಪರೆ ವಿಚಕ್ಷಣಂ ಸಪ್ತಚಕ್ರೇ ಷಳರ ಆಹುರರ್ಪಿತಂ ॥ ;
ಪಂಚಾರೇ ಚಕ್ರೇ ಪರಿವರ್ತಮಾನೇ ತಸ್ಮಿನ್ನಾ ತಸ್ಥುರ್ಭುವನಾನಿ ವಿಶ್ವಾ ।
ತಸ್ಯ ನಾಕ್ಷಸ್ತಪ್ಯತೇ ಭೂರಿಭಾರಃ ಸನಾದೇವ ನ ಶೀರ್ಯತೇ ಸನಾಭಿಃ ॥
ಹನ್ನೆರಡು ಅರಗಳುಳ್ಳ (ಮಾಸ) ಆದಿತ್ಯನ ಚಕ್ರವು ಅಂತರಿಕ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಆವೃತ್ತಿರೂಪವಾದ ಪರಿಭ್ರಮಣವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರು
ತ್ತದೆ. ಅದು ಕ್ಷಯವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದದೆ ಶಾಶ್ವತವಾದ ಭ್ರಮಣವುಳ್ಳದ್ದು. ಮಿಥುನರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿರುವುದೂ ಏಳನೂರ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು
ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳುಳ್ಳದ್ದೂ, ಆದಿತ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಶಿಶುರೂಪದ್ದೂ ಆದ ಅಹೋರಾತ್ರಗಳ ದ್ವಯವು ಈ ಕಾಲಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತರ್ಗತ
ವಾಗಿದೆ. ಅಯನಾದ್ಯವಯವಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದ ಈ ಕಾಲಚಕ್ರವು ಸತತವಾಗಿ ತನ್ನ ಭ್ರಮಣವನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸು
ತ್ತದೆ. ಇದೇ ವಿಶ್ವತತ್ತ್ವವು. ಈ ತತ್ತ್ವವು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಕರ್ತನಾದ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತರ್ಗತವಾಗಿಯೂ, ಅವನ
ಬಾಹ್ಯತತ್ತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬಿಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಇದೆ. ಈ ಕಾಲತತ್ತ್ವವನ್ನು ಸಂಹಿತೆ, ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ ಮತ್ತು ಉಪನಿಷತ್ತು
ಗಳಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲಾ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ವಿಧಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣಿಸಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾಲತತ್ತ್ವಕ್ಕೂ ಯಜ್ಞತತ್ತ್ವಕ್ಕೂ ತಾದಾತ್ಮವನ್ನು

ಚಕ್ಷುಸ್ಸು, ವಾಯುವೇ ಪ್ರಾಣವು, ಅಗ್ನಿವೈಶ್ವಾನರನೇ ಮುಖವು, ಸಂವತ್ಸರವು ದೇಹವು, .... .... .... ಋತುಗಳೇ
ಅಂಗಗಳು, ಮಾಸಾರ್ಧಮಾಸಗಳೇ ಪರ್ವಗಳು, ಅಹೋರಾತ್ರಗಳೇ ಆಧಾರಸ್ತಂಭಗಳು, ಇತ್ಯಾದಿಕ್ರಮಗಳಿಂದ
ವರ್ಣಿಸಿದೆ. ಈ ವರ್ಣನೆಯು ಪ್ರಕೃತವಾದ (೧-೧೫೫-೬) ಋಕ್ಕಿನ ಭಾಷ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಲಾತ್ಮಕೋ ವಿಷ್ಣುಃ, ವಿವಿಧಮಾತ್ಮಾನಂ ವಿಮಾನಃ ದೇವತಿರಗಾತ್ಮನಾ ವಿಭಜ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಾಪಯನ್ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿರುವಂತೆ ವಿಶ್ವತತ್ತ್ವವನ್ನೊಳ
ಗೊಂಡ ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕನಾದ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಯ ವರ್ಣನೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ತತ್ತ್ವಪ್ರತಿಪಾದನೆಯೇ ಮುಂದೆ ಉಪನಿಷದಾದಿ
ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸುವ ಭೌತಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಧಾರವಾದುದೆಂದು ಪಾಶ್ಚಾತ್ಯ ಪಂಡಿತರು ಈ ಪ್ರತಿಪಾ
ದನೆಯನ್ನು ಶ್ಲಾಘಿಸಿ ಈ ರೀತಿ ತಮ್ಮ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿರುವರು.

In the elaborate rite of the piling of the fire-aliars lies the most philosophic content of the Samhita, for in it finds expression the chief doctrine of the sacrificial ritual, the sacrifice as a cosmic power of the highest potency. The first expression of it is preserved
in the litarature of the Purusha hymn of the Rig-Veda ( X-90 ) where the creation of
the universe is figured as the sacrifice of a Primeval Purusha, who is all that is and that
shall be. This creation cannot be regarded as ever proceeding, and the year, the symbol of
time, takes its part in that the three seasons, spring, summer, and autums form the ghee,
the kindling sticks and the oblation, undoubtedly an attempt to recognise and explain time
in its relation to the Universe.
(A. B. Keith :—The Taittiriya Samhika—I. Introduction : Harvard Oriental Series
The Satapatha Brahmana in the tenth book ( X. 6·4 ), which deals with the secret of,
the fire, develops the theme more philosophically. Prajapathi is the year, for he is essentially,
as the creator, time, and the year is at once the symbol of  time, and the period in which the
working of nature completes a round and commences again.
( A. B. Keith. The Religion and Philosophy of the Veda—Vol. II P. 466. )

ಜೀವನವೂ ಸಹ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕವಾದ ಆದ್ಯಂತಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿರುವುದಾಗಿಯೂ ಒಟ್ಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅನಾದ್ಯನಂತವಾದ ಭ್ರಮಣ
ಪ್ರವಾಹವುಳ್ಳದ್ದಾಗಿಯೂ ಅನುಸ್ಯೂತವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ವಿವರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಗಾಢವಾದ ವಿಶ್ವತತ್ತ್ವವು
ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶ್ವತತ್ತ್ವವೆಲ್ಲವೂ ಅವನ ದೇಹದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತರ್ಗತವಾಗಿರುವುದೆಂದು
ಪ್ರಕೃತವಾದ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣಿಸಿರುವಂತೆ ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮನಾದ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಲಾತ್ಮಕವಾದ ಸಕಲ ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳೂ
ಅಡಗಿವೆಯೆಂದೂ, ಮತ್ತು, ಅಗ್ನಿ, ವಿಷ್ಣು, ಆದಿತ್ಯ, ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿ ಇವರೆಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಂದೇ ವಿಶ್ವತತ್ತ್ವವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬಿ
ಸುವರೆಂದೂ, ವಿಶ್ವದ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳಿಗೆಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾಲವೇ ಆಧಾರವೆಂದೂ, ಆ ಕಾಲವು ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿರೂಪಿಯಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ
ವಿಶ್ವರೂಪಂ ಹರಿಣಂ ಜಾತವೇದಸಂ ಪರಾಯಣಂ ಜ್ಯೋತಿರೇಕಂ ತಪಂತಂ ।
ಸಹಸ್ರರಶ್ಮಿಃ ಶತಧಾ ವರ್ತಮಾನಃ ಪ್ರಾಣಃ ಪ್ರಜಾನಾಮುದಯತ್ಯೇಷ ಸೂರ್ಯಃ ॥
ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಕಲಭೂತಗಳಿಗೂ ಪ್ರಾಣರೂಪನಾದ ಆದಿತ್ಯನು ವಿಶ್ವರೂಪಿಯೂ ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞನೂ, ಪರಾಯಣನೂ
(The final goal). ವಿಶ್ವಕ್ಕೆಲ್ಲಾ ಏಕಜ್ಯೋತಿಯೂ, ಸಹಸ್ರಾರು ರೂಪಗಳಲ್ಲಿರತಕ್ಕವನೂ ಆಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ ಎಂದು
ಸಂವತ್ಸರೋ ವೈ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಸ್ತಸ್ಯಾಯನೇ ದಕ್ಷಿಣಂ ಚೋತ್ತರಂ ಚ ।
ಪಂಚಪಾದಂ ಪಿತರಂ ದ್ವಾದಶಾಕೃತಿಂ ದಿವ ಆಹುಃ ಪರೇ ಅರ್ಧೇ ಪುರೀಷಿಣಂ ।
ಅಥೇಮೇ ಅನ್ಯ ಉಪರೇ ವಿಚಕ್ಷಣಂ ಸಪ್ತಚಕ್ರೇ ಷಳರ ಆಹುರರ್ಪಿತಂ ॥
ಮಾಸೋ ವೈ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಸ್ತಸ್ಯ ಕೃಷ್ಣಪಕ್ಷ ಏವ ರಯಿಃ ಶುಕ್ಲಃ ಪ್ರಾಣಃ ।
ಅಹೋರಾತ್ರೋ ವೈ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಸ್ತಸ್ಯಾಹರೇವ ಪ್ರಾಣೋ ರಾತ್ರಿರೇವ ರಯಿಃ ।
ಎಂಬ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಹೋರಾತ್ರಗಳಿಗೂ, ಮಾಸಕ್ಕೂ, ಪಕ್ಷಗಳಿಗೂ, ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಗೂ ತಾದಾತ್ಮವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿ
ಕಾಲದ ಸಕಲ ಅವಯವಗಳೂ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಯ ಅಂಶಗಳೆಂದೇ ಹೇಳಿದೆ.
ಹೀಗೆ ಮೇಲೆ ಉದಹರಿಸಿರುವ ಶ್ರುತಿವಾಕ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೂ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಗೂ ಅವಯವಾವಯವಿ
ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಕೃತವಾದ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೂ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿಗಇ ಅವಯವಾವಯವಿಸಂಬಂಧ
ವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿದೆಯೆಂದು ಆಶಂಕೆಯುಂಟಾಗುವುದಾದರೆ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಯೂ ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮನು ; ವಿಷ್ಣುವೂ ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮನು ಎಂದು ಅಭೇದಬೋಧಕಗಳಾದ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಬಹುದು.
ಏಷ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮೈಷ ಇಂದ್ರ ಏಷ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿರೇತೇ ಸರ್ವೇ ದೇವಾ ಇಮಾನಿ ಚ ಪಂಚ
ಮಹಾಭೂತಾನಿ ಪೃಥಿವೀ ವಾಯುರಾಕಾಶ ಆಪೋ ಜ್ಯೋತೀಂಷೀತ್ಯೇತಾನೀಮಾನಿ ಚ
ಇತ್ಯಾದಿವಾಕ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಯು ಸರ್ವಾತ್ಮನೆಂದು ವರ್ಣಿಸಿದೆ. ಸಾಯಣರು ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವನ್ನು
ಸರ್ವಾತ್ಮನೆಂದು ಹೇಳುವಂತೆ ಈ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಆದಿತ್ಯಾತ್ಮನಾದ ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿಯನ್ನು ಸರ್ವಾತ್ಮನೆಂದು ಹೇಳಿದೆ.
ಆದಿತ್ಯನೇ ಕಾಲಾತ್ಮಕನು-ಕಾಲಾಧಾರನು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಲಿಕವಾದ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಕನು. ಆದುದರಿಂದ ಆದಿತ್ಯಾ
ತ್ಮಕನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವು ತನ್ನ ಭ್ರಮಣವನ್ನೂ ಕಾಲಗಳ ಭ್ರಮಣಗಳನ್ನೂ ಅಭೇದರೂಪದಿಂದ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಿರುವನೆಂದು
ಸಾಯಣರಃಸಮಾಧಾನವು, ಅಥವಾ ಸ್ವಭ್ರಮಣಾಧೀನತ್ವಾದಿತರೇಷಾಂ ಪರಿಭ್ರಮಣಸ್ಯ । ಅತಃ ಸ್ವಯಂ
ವಿಮಿಮಾನಃ—ವಿವಿಧಮಾತ್ಮನಂ ಮಿಮಾನಃ ದೇವತಿರ್ಯಗಾತ್ಮನಾ ವಿಭಜ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಾಪಯನ್ । ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ
ವಾದ ತನ್ನ ಆತ್ಮತತ್ತ್ವವನ್ನು ದೇವತಿರ್ಯಗಾದಿರೂಪಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಕಾಸಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಬೇರೆಬೇರೆ ರೂಪಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸುತ್ತಾ
ಎಂದರ್ಥಮಾಡಿದೆ. ತಾನೇ ವಿಧವಿಧವಾದ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿ ಮೂಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಐಕ್ಯವಿದ್ದರೂ ಕಾರ್ಯರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ
en: Here the greatness of Viṣṇu, whose nature is the Āditya, is praised. When the Nirukta-writer shows the explanation of the word स्वसराणि (*svasarāṇi*), he says: स्वरादित्यो भवति स एनानि सारयति । (*svarādityo bhavati sa enāni sārayati |*) (Ni. 5-4). It is stated that the Āditya is named स्वः (*svaḥ*) because he makes the days move. In this Ṛk the power of Viṣṇu, whose nature is the Āditya, consisting in revolution, and the fact that he sets in motion time and all other principles, are described.
चतुर्भिस्साकं नवतिं च (*caturbhissākaṃ navatiṃ ca*)—एतत्संख्याकान् कालावयवान् । (*etatsaṃkhyākān kālāvayavān |*) Thus the parts of time are divided into ninety-four. They are:
- The signs beginning with Meṣa (एकस्मिन्दिने पर्यावर्तमानानि मेषादीनि (*ekasmindine paryāvartamānāni meṣādīni*), द्वादश लग्नानि (*dvādaśa lagnāni*)): 12
Thus the parts of time are ninety-four in all.
व्यतीन् (*vyatīn*)—विविधातनस्वभावान्। (*vividhātanasvabhāvān|*) It is described that he sets in motion all these parts of time that exist in different forms.

The commentator shows that room is left here for another doubt, and gives the fitting answer: नन्वादित्यः स्वयमपि इतरवत्परिभ्रमति कथं भ्रमयति इत्युच्यते । (*nanvādityaḥ svayamapi itaravatparibhramati kathaṃ bhramayati ityucyate |*)

Raising the doubt that, since the Āditya himself has the nature of revolution like the other planets and so on, how can he make other things move, the commentator answers that there is nothing unnatural in the description, because all other things in the world are only other forms of Viṣṇu, and because all their movements depend on the revolution of Viṣṇu who is the Āditya.

In answering this objection Sāyaṇa has given in summary the cosmic principle whose nature is time. By saying कालात्मकः विष्णुः (*kālātmakaḥ viṣṇuḥ*) and by विराडात्मना सर्वदेवमनुष्यादिशरीराणां स्वशरीरत्वात् (*virāḍātmanā sarvadevamanuṣyādiśarīrāṇāṃ svaśarīratvāt*) he states the identity of Viṣṇu with the universe, and that the whole activity of the universe depends on Viṣṇu's action. By the epithet विमिमानः (*vimimānaḥ*) it is said that Viṣṇu (who is described in another form as Prajāpati) is the cause even of creation, maintenance and the rest. By describing, in one place in one way and in another place in another, the ninety-four parts of time, of wheel-form, belonging to Viṣṇu who is the Āditya, it is shown that these are the very principles of Prajāpati, the cause of the universe.

द्वादशारं नहि तज्ञराय वर्वर्ति चक्रं परि द्यामृतस्य । आ पुत्रा अग्ने मिथुनासो अत्र सप्त शतानि विंशतिश्च तस्थुः । (*dvādaśāraṃ nahi tajñarāya varvarti cakraṃ pari dyāmṛtasya | ā putrā agne mithunāso atra sapta śatāni viṃśatiśca tasthuḥ |*) (Ṛ. Saṃ. 1-164-11)
सत्यात्मकस्यादित्यस्य चक्रं पुनःपुनः क्रमणशीलं मंडलाख्यं रथचक्रं वा वर्वति । (*satyātmakasyādityasya cakraṃ punaḥpunaḥ kramaṇaśīlaṃ maṃḍalākhyaṃ rathacakraṃ vā varvati |*)

पंचपादं पितरं द्वादशाकृतिं दिव आहुः परे अर्धे पुरीषिणं । अथेमे अन्य उपरॆ विचक्षणं सप्तचक्रे षळर आहुरर्पितं ॥ ; (*paṃcapādaṃ pitaraṃ dvādaśākṛtiṃ diva āhuḥ pare ardhe purīṣiṇaṃ | atheme anya uparè vicakṣaṇaṃ saptacakre ṣaḷara āhurarpitaṃ ‖ ;*) (Ṛ. Saṃ. 1-164-12)

पंचारे चक्रे परिवर्तमाने तस्मिन्ना तस्थुर्भुवनानि विश्वा । तस्य नाक्षस्तप्यते भूरिभारः सनादेव न शीर्यते सनाभिः ॥ (*paṃcāre cakre parivartamāne tasminnā tasthurbhuvanāni viśvā | tasya nākṣastapyate bhūribhāraḥ sanādeva na śīryate sanābhiḥ ‖*) (Ṛ. Saṃ. 1-164-13)

The wheel of the Āditya, with twelve spokes (the months), has in the sky a revolution of repeated turning. It suffers no decay, its revolution is everlasting. The pair of days-and-nights, in twinned form, of seven hundred and twenty in number, for the Āditya of infant form, is contained within this wheel of time. This wheel of time, made up of the solstices and other parts, continues its revolution without break. This is the cosmic principle. This principle is contained in Prajāpati the creator, and reflects his outer principles. This principle of time is described in various ways in the Saṃhitā, Brāhmaṇa and Upaniṣads
everywhere. Showing the identity of this principle of time and the principle of sacrifice, and that Prajāpati is the support of both, the Taittirīya Saṃhitā describes it thus:

प्रजापतिरग्निमचिनुतर्तुभिस्संवध्सरं वसंतेनैवास्य पूर्वार्धमचिनुत ग्रीष्मेण दक्षिणं पक्षं वर्षाभिः पुच्छग्ं शरदोत्तरं पक्षग्ं हेमंतेन मध्यं ब्रह्मणा वा अस्य तत्पूर्वार्ध मचिनुत क्षत्रेण दक्षिणं पक्षं पशुभिः पुच्छं विशोत्तरं पक्षमाशया मध्यं य एवं विद्वानग्निं चिनुत ऋतुभिरेवैनं चिनुतेऽथो एतदेव सर्वमव ॥ (*prajāpatiragnimacinutartubhissaṃvadhsaraṃ vasaṃtenaivāsya pūrvārdhamacinuta grīṣmeṇa dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣaṃ varṣābhiḥ pucchagṃ śaradottaraṃ pakṣagṃ hemaṃtena madhyaṃ brahmaṇā vā asya tatpūrvārdha macinuta kṣatreṇa dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣaṃ paśubhiḥ pucchaṃ viśottaraṃ pakṣamāśayā madhyaṃ ya evaṃ vidvānagniṃ cinuta ṛtubhirevainaṃ cinute 'tho etadeva sarvamava ‖*) (Tai. Saṃ. 5-6-10-1)

It says that, as the year is built of the seasons, spring and the rest, he built all the parts of the sacrificial altar, the eastern and the others. And in the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, showing the identity of the sacrificial horse, whose form is Prajāpati, with the parts of time:

उषा वा अश्वस्य (*uṣā vā aśvasya*) … सिंधवो .... .... .... वागेवास्य नागहर्वा अश्वं पुरस्तान्महिमान्वजायत तस्य पूर्वे समुद्रे योनी रात्रिरेनु पश्चान्महिमान्वजायत ................. !! (*siṃdhavo .... .... .... vāgevāsya nāgaharvā aśvaṃ purastānmahimānvajāyata tasya pūrve samudre yonī rātrirenu paścānmahimānvajāyata ................. !!*) ⟨NOTE:426⟩ (Śa. Brā. 10-6-4-1) ⟨NOTE:427⟩

It describes: for the sacrificial horse in the form of Prajāpati, or Prajāpati in the form of the sacrificial horse, the dawn is the head, the sun the eye, the wind the breath, the fire Vaiśvānara the mouth, the year the body, .... .... .... the seasons the limbs, the months and half-months the joints, the days-and-nights the supporting pillars, and so on. This description, as explained in the bhāṣya on the present Ṛk (1-155-6) by कालात्मको विष्णुः (*kālātmako viṣṇuḥ*) and विविधमात्मानं विमानः देवतिरगात्मना विभज्य स्थापयन् (*vividhamātmānaṃ vimānaḥ devatiragātmanā vibhajya sthāpayan*), is the description of Prajāpati, whose nature is the Āditya, containing the cosmic principle. Western scholars, praising this exposition as the basis of the physical and spiritual principles later set out in the Upaniṣads and elsewhere, have stated their view thus:

In the elaborate rite of the piling of the fire-aliars lies the most philosophic content of the Samhita, for in it finds expression the chief doctrine of the sacrificial ritual, the sacrifice as a cosmic power of the highest potency. The first expression of it is preserved

The passage on the Purusha hymn of the Ṛgveda (X-90) continues: there the creation of the universe is figured as the sacrifice of a Primeval Purusha, who is all that is and that shall be. This creation cannot be regarded as ever proceeding, and the year, the symbol of time, takes its part in that the three seasons, spring, summer and autumn form the ghee, the kindling sticks and the oblation, undoubtedly an attempt to recognise and explain time in its relation to the Universe.
(A. B. Keith: The Taittirīya Saṃhitā — I. Introduction: Harvard Oriental Series Vol. 18, p. CXXVI)

The Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa in the tenth book (X. 6·4), which deals with the secret of the fire, develops the theme more philosophically. Prajāpati is the year, for he is essentially, as the creator, time, and the year is at once the symbol of time, and the period in which the working of nature completes a round and commences again.
(A. B. Keith, The Religion and Philosophy of the Veda, Vol. II, p. 466.)

The summary of the above opinion is that a profound cosmic principle lies hidden in this account: just as the year, together with its beginning and end and its parts such as the solstices, goes on continuously and endlessly by repeated recurrences, so also the life of the universe proceeds continuously, with individual beginnings and ends, yet as a whole with a beginningless, endless flow of revolution.

Just as the present Ṛk describes the whole cosmic principle as contained in the body of Viṣṇu, who is of the nature of the Sun, so the Upaniṣads and other texts describe all the principles of the nature of time as contained in Prajāpati, who is of the nature of the Sun; Agni, Viṣṇu, Āditya and Prajāpati all reflect one cosmic principle; time is the basis of all the affairs of the world; and that time is a part of Viṣṇu in the form of Prajāpati.

विश्वरूपं हरिणं जातवेदसं परायणं ज्योतिरेकं तपंतं । सहस्ररश्मिः शतधा वर्तमानः प्राणः प्रजानामुदयत्येष सूर्यः ॥ (*viśvarūpaṃ hariṇaṃ jātavedasaṃ parāyaṇaṃ jyotirekaṃ tapaṃtaṃ | sahasraraśmiḥ śatadhā vartamānaḥ prāṇaḥ prajānāmudayatyeṣa sūryaḥ ‖*) (Praśna Upaniṣad, 1-8). In this passage Āditya, the life-breath of all beings, is described as the universal-formed, the omniscient, the final goal (parāyaṇa), the one light of the whole world, existing in thousands of forms; the sun, the Āditya who is the soul of the universe, is thus described, and then:

पंचपादं पितरं द्वादशाकृतिं दिव आहुः परे अर्धे पुरीषिणं । अथेमे अन्य उपरे विचक्षणं सप्तचक्रे षळर आहुरर्पितं ॥ ( (*paṃcapādaṃ pitaraṃ dvādaśākṛtiṃ diva āhuḥ pare ardhe purīṣiṇaṃ | atheme anya upare vicakṣaṇaṃ saptacakre ṣaḷara āhurarpitaṃ ‖ (*)
मासो वै प्रजापतिस्तस्य कृष्णपक्ष एव रयिः शुक्लः प्राणः । (*māso vai prajāpatistasya kṛṣṇapakṣa eva rayiḥ śuklaḥ prāṇaḥ |*)
अहोरात्रो वै प्रजापतिस्तस्याहरेव प्राणो रात्रिरेव रयिः । (*ahorātro vai prajāpatistasyāhareva prāṇo rātrireva rayiḥ |*)
In these passages the identity of day-and-night, the month, the fortnights and Prajāpati is stated, and all the parts of time are said to be portions of Prajāpati.

Thus in all the Śruti passages quoted above a relation of part and whole is stated between time and Prajāpati, while in the present Ṛk such a relation is stated between time and Viṣṇu; if this raises a doubt, one may look at passages that teach non-difference: Prajāpati is of the nature of the Sun, and Viṣṇu is of the nature of the Sun.

एष ब्रह्मैष इंद्र एष प्रजापतिरेते सर्वे देवा इमानि च पंच महाभूतानि पृथिवी वायुराकाश आपो ज्योतींषीत्येतानीमानि च क्षुद्रमिश्राणीव ॥ (*eṣa brahmaiṣa iṃdra eṣa prajāpatirete sarve devā imāni ca paṃca mahābhūtāni pṛthivī vāyurākāśa āpo jyotīṃṣītyetānīmāni ca kṣudramiśrāṇīva ‖*) (Aitareya Upaniṣad 3-3)
देवो वरुणः प्रजापतिः सविता । (*devo varuṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ savitā |*) (Chā. U. 1-12-5)

In these and similar passages Prajāpati is described as the soul of all. Just as Sāyaṇa calls Viṣṇu, who is of the nature of the Sun, the soul of all, so in these passages Prajāpati, of the nature of the Sun, is called the soul of all. The Sun is of the nature of time, the basis of time, and the impeller of temporal activities. Hence Sāyaṇa's solution is that Viṣṇu, who is of the nature of the Sun, carries on his own revolution and the revolutions of the times as non-different; this is supported by the sentence स्वभ्रमणाधीनत्वादितरेषां परिभ्रमणस्य । अतः स्वयं भ्रमतीत्युच्यते । (*svabhramaṇādhīnatvāditareṣāṃ paribhramaṇasya | ataḥ svayaṃ bhramatītyucyate |*)

विमिमानः (*vimimānaḥ*)—विविधमात्मनं मिमानः देवतिर्यगात्मना विभज्य स्थापयन् । (*vividhamātmanaṃ mimānaḥ devatiryagātmanā vibhajya sthāpayan |*) This is explained as: developing his own subtle self-principle in forms such as gods and animals, and establishing it in different forms. The purport is: though one in origin, he himself undergoes manifold transformations and in effect takes on different states and forms.

en: - चतुर्भिः — झल्युपोत्तम् (पा. सू. ८६-१-१८०) इति झलादिविभक्त्यंतत्वात् उपोत्तम उदात्तं भवति ।
- व्यतीन् — वि उपसर्गः । अत सातत्यगमने धातुः । इन् सार्वधातुभ्यः इति इन् प्रत्ययः । नित्त्वात् आद्युदात्तस्वरो भवति । प्रथमाबहुवचनांतरूपम् ।
- वृत्तम् — वृतु वर्तने धातुः । अस्मात् निष्ठा क्त प्रत्ययः । कित्त्वात् लघूपधगुणो न भवति । प्रत्ययस्वरो भवति ।

- अवीविपत् — टुवेपृ कंपने धातुः । हेतुमति च (पा. सू. ३-१-२६) इति णिच् । णिजंतात् लुज् । प्रथमपुरुषैकवचने ति प्रत्ययः । इतश्च इति इकारलोपः । णिश्रिद्रुसुभ्यः (पा. सू. ३-१-८४) इति कर्तरि चज् । णौचङ्जुपधायाः ह्रस्वः (पा सव. ७-४-१) इति धातोरुपधाया ह्रस्वः । एचइत् ह्रस्वादेशे इति इकारो भवति । चजि (पा. सू. ६-१-११) इति द्वित्वम् । सन्वल्लघुनि चज् (पा सू. ७-४-९३) इति सन्वद्भावे सति दीर्घो लघोः (पा सू ७-४-९४) इति अभ्यासस्य दीर्घः । णेरनिटि (पा. सू. ६-४-५१) इति णिचो लोपः । अंगस्य अडागमः । अतिजंतस्य परत्वात् निघातस्वरो भवति ।
- बृहत् शरीरः — बृहत् शरीरः यस्य सः । बहुव्रीहौ प्रकृत्या पूर्वपदम् (पा.सू. ६-२-१) इति पूर्वपदप्रकृतिस्वरो भवति ।

- विमिमानः — माज् माने धातुः । जुहोत्यादिः । लडर्थे शानच् प्रत्ययः । श्लौ इति धातोर्द्वित्वम् । बृञामित् (पा. सू. ७-४-७६) इति अभ्यासस्य इत्वम् । अभ्यस्तानामादिः (पा. सू. ६-१-८९) इति आद्युदात्तस्वरो भवति । प्रादिसमासे कृदुत्तरपदप्रकृतिस्वरो भवति ।
- ऋक्वभिः — ऋच स्तुतौ धातुः । अन्येभ्योऽपिदृश्यंते (पा. सू. ३-२-३५) इति क्वनिप् प्रत्ययः । व्यत्ययेन कुत्वं भवति । प्रत्ययस्य पित्त्वात् अनुदात्तत्वं भवति ।
- अकुमारः — न कुमारः अकुमारः । तत्पुरुषेकुतुल्या- (पा. सू. ६-२-२) इति नञ् पूर्वपदप्रकृतिस्वरो भवति ।
- आहवम् — आज् उपसर्गे धातुः । ह्वेञ् स्पर्धायां शब्दे च धातुः । व्यत्ययेन भावार्थे अट् प्रत्ययः । बहुलं छंदसि इति संप्रसारणम् । पूर्वरूपम् । उकारस्य ग.१.
- (आहवम् इत्यस्य शेषः) अवादेशः । समासे कृदुत्तरपदप्रकृतिस्वरो भवति । अथवा आजियुद्धे (पा. सू. ३-३-७३) इति आगतः अप् प्रत्ययः व्यत्ययेन अत्रापि भवति । ⟨NOTE:429⟩

kn: ಭವಾ ಮಿತ್ರ ಇತಿ ಪಂಚರ್ಚಂ ಸಪ್ತದಶಂ ಸೂಕ್ತಂ ದೈರ್ಘತಮಸಂ । ಜಾಗತಂತ್ವಿತ್ಯುಕ್ತತ್ವಾದಿದಮಪಿ ಜಾಗತಂ । ವೈಷ್ಣವಂ ಹೀತ್ಯುಕ್ತತ್ವಾದ್ವೈಷ್ಣವಂ । ಭವ ಪಂಚೇತ್ಯನುಕ್ರಾಂತಂ ॥ ಉಕ್ಷ್ಯೇ
ತೃತೀಯಸವನೇಚ್ಛಾವಾಕಶಸ್ತ್ರ ಏತತ್ಸೂಕ್ತಂ ವಿನಿಯುಕ್ತಂ । ಉಕ್ಷ್ಯೇ ತು ಹೋತ್ರಕಾಣಾಮಿತಿ ಖಂಡೇ
ಸೂತ್ರಿತಂ । ಭವಾ ಮಿತ್ರಃ ಸಂ ನಾಂ ಕರ್ಮಣಾ । ಆ. ೬-೧ ॥ ಇತಿ !! ಸೌಮ್ಯಚರೋರುಭಯತೋ
ಧೃತೇನ ಯಷ್ಟವ್ಯಂ ತತ್ರೋಪರಿತನೇ ಧೃತಯಾಗ ಉರು ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ವಿ ಕ್ರಮಸ್ವೀತಿ ಪ್ರಾಕೃತಾ ಯಾಜ್ಯಾ ।
ದಶಮೇಽಹನಿ ತು ತಸ್ಯಾಃ ಸ್ಥಾನೇ ಭವಾ ಮಿತ್ರ ಇತ್ಯೇಷಾ ಪ್ರಯೋಕ್ತವ್ಯಾ । ದಶಮೇಽಹನೀತಿ ಖಂಡೇ
ಸೂತ್ರಿತಂ । ಉರು ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ವಿ ಕ್ರಮಸ್ವೀತಿ ಧೃತಯಜ್ಯಾಸ್ಥಾನೇ ಭವಾ ಮಿತ್ರಃ । ಆ. ೮-೧೨ । ಇತಿ ॥
ಅನುವಾದವು—ಭವಾ ಮಿತ್ರ ಎಂಬ ಈ ಸೂಕ್ತವು ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತೊಂದನೆಯ ಅನುವಾಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಹದಿನೇಳನೆಯ
ಸೂಕ್ತವು. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಐದು ಋಕ್ಕುಗಳಿರುವುವು. ಈ ಸೂಕ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ಉಚಥ್ಯಪುತ್ರನಾದ ದೀರ್ಘತಮಸ್ ಎಂಬುವನು
ಋಷಿಯು- ವಿಷ್ಣುವು ದೇವತೆಯು. ಜಗತೀಛಂದಸ್ಸು. ಅನುಕ್ರಮಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭವ ಪಂಚ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿರು
ವುದು. ಉಕ್ಥ್ಯವೆಂಬ ಯಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ತೃತೀಯಸವನಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಚ್ಛಾವಾಕನೆಂಬ ಋತ್ವಿಜನು ಈ ಸೂಕ್ತವನ್ನು
ಪಠಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದು ಆಶ್ವಲಾಯನಶೌತಸೂತ್ರದ ಉಕ್ಥೇ ತು ಹೋತ್ರಾಣಾಂ ಎಂಬ ಖಂಡದ ಭವಾ ಮಿತ್ರಃ ಸಂ
ನಾಂ ಕರ್ಮಣಾ ಎಂಬ ಸೂತ್ರದಿಂದ ವಿವೃತವಾಗಿರುವುದು. (ಆ. ೬-೧) ಸೋಮಸಂಬಂಧವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾದ
ಎರಡು ಚರುಹೋಮಗಳಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ತುಪ್ಪವನ್ನು ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸಿ ಹೋಮಮಾಡಬೇಕು. ಈ ಧೃತಯಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ
ಉರು ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ವಿಕ್ರಮಸ್ವ ಎಂಬ ಋಕ್ಕನ್ನು ಪ್ರಾಕೃತಯಾಜ್ಯಾಮಂತ್ರವನ್ನಾಗಿ ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದೂ ಆದರೆ
ಹತ್ತನೆಯ ದಿವಸ ಹಿಂದೆ ಹೇಳಿದ ಉರು ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ವಿಕ್ರಮಸ್ವ ಎಂಬ ಋಕ್ಕಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗಿ ಭವಾಮಿತ್ರ ಎಂಬ
ಋಕ್ಕನ್ನು ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದೂ ಆಶ್ವಲಾಯನಶೌತಸೂತ್ರದ ದಶಮೇಽಹನಿ ಎಂಬ ಖಂಡದ ಉರು ವಿಷ್ಣೋ
ವಿಕ್ರಮಸ್ವೇತಿ ಧೃತಯಾಜ್ಯಾಸ್ಥಾನೇ ಭವಾ ಮಿತ್ರಃ ಎಂಬ ಸೂತ್ರವು ನಿರ್ದೇಶಿಸುವುದು. (ಆ. ೮-೧೨)
en: Introduction (the printed Sanskrit introduction): the sūkta भवा मित्र (*bhavā mitra*) of five Ṛks is the seventeenth sūkta; it is by Dīrghatamas, of the Dairghatamasa line; since it is said "jāgata" it is also jāgata (Jagatī metre); since "vaiṣṇava" is said, it is Viṣṇu's; the Anukramaṇī says भव पंच (*bhava paṃca*). It is applied in the Ukthya rite, at the third pressing, for the Acchāvāka's recitation; the Sūtra in the section उक्ष्ये तु होत्रकाणामिति (*ukṣye tu hotrakāṇāmiti*) prescribes it: भवा मित्रः सं नां कर्मणा (*bhavā mitraḥ saṃ nāṃ karmaṇā*) (Ā. 6-1). In the Saumya-caru, ghee is to be used on both sides; in the upper ghee-offering the ordinary yājyā is उरु विष्णो वि क्रमस्व (*uru viṣṇo vi kramasva*); on the tenth day this Ṛk भवा मित्र (*bhavā mitra*) is to be used in its place, as the section दशमेऽहनि (*daśame 'hani*) states: उरु विष्णो वि क्रमस्वीति धृतयज्यास्थाने भवा मित्रः (*uru viṣṇo vi kramasvīti dhṛtayajyāsthāne bhavā mitraḥ*) (Ā. 8-12).

**Anuvāda.** This sūkta भवा मित्र (*bhavā mitra*) is the seventeenth sūkta in the twenty-first anuvāka. It has five Ṛks. Its seer is Dīrghatamas, son of Ucathya; the deity is Viṣṇu; the metre Jagatī. The Anukramaṇī says "bhava pañca". In the Ukthya sacrifice, at the third pressing, the priest called Acchāvāka is to recite this sūkta, as explained by the Āśvalāyana Śrauta Sūtra, in the section "Ukthe tu hotrāṇām", by the sūtra "Bhavā mitraḥ saṃ nāṃ karmaṇā" (Ā. 6-1). In both caru-oblations connected with Soma, ghee is to be used; in this ghee-offering the Ṛk "Uru viṣṇo vi kramasva" is to be used as the ordinary yājyā; but on the tenth day the Ṛk "Bhavā mitra" is to be used in place of it, as the sūtra "Uru viṣṇo vikramasveti dhṛtayājyāsthāne bhavā mitraḥ" in the section "Daśame 'hani" of the Āśvalāyana Śrauta Sūtra directs (Ā. 8-12).
Maṇḍala 1, Anuvāka 21, Sūkta 156; Aṣṭaka 2, Adhyāya 2, Varga 26. Number of Ṛks in the sūkta: 5. Seer: Dīrghatamas Aucathya. Deity: Viṣṇu. Metre: Jagatī.

kn: ಭವಾ ಮಿತ್ರೋ ನ ಶೇವ್ಯೋ ಘೃತಾಸುತಿರ್ವಿಭೂತದ್ಯುಮ್ನ ಏವಯಾ ಉ
ಅಧಾ ತೇ ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ವಿದುಷಾ ಚಿದರ್ಧ್ಯಃ ಸ್ತೋಮೋ ಯಜ್ಞಶ್ಚ ರಾಧ್ಯೋ
ref: भवा॑ मि॒त्रो न शेव्यो॑ घृ॒तासु॑ति॒र्विभू॑तद्युम्न एव॒या उ॑ स॒प्रथा॑ः।
अधा॑ ते विष्णो वि॒दुषा॑ चि॒दर्ध्य॒ः स्तोमो॑ य॒ज्ञश्च॒ राध्यो॑ ह॒विष्म॑ता

kn: ಭವ । ಮಿತ್ರಃ । ನ । ಶೇವ್ಯಃ । ಧೃತಆಸುತಿಃ । ವಿಭೂತದ್ಯುಮ್ನಃ । ಏವಯಾಃ । ಊಂ ಇತಿ ।
ಅಧ । ತೇ । ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ಇತಿ । ವಿದುಷಾ । ಚಿತ್ । ಅಧ್ಯ ೯ಃ । ಸ್ತೋಮಃ । ಯಜ್ಞಃ । ಚ । ರಾಧ್ಯಃ ।
ಹೇ ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ಮಿತ್ರೋ ನ । ಮಿತೇರ್ದುಃಖಾತ್ ತ್ರಾತಾ ಸಖಾ ಆದಿತ್ಯೋ ನಾ ಮಿತ್ರಃ । ಪ್ರಮೀತೇಸ್ತ್ರಾಯತ ಇತಿ ನಿರುಕ್ತಂ । ೧೦-೨೧ । ತದ್ವತ್ ಶೇವ್ಯಃ ಸುಖೇ ಸಾಧುಃ ಸುಖಕರ್ತಾ ಘೃತಾಸುತಿಃ
ಧೃತಮುದಕಮಾಸೂಯತೇ ಯೇನ ಸ ತಾದೃಶಃ । ಯದ್ವಾ । ಧೃತಮಾಜ್ಯಮಾಭಿಮುಖ್ಯೇನ ನೀಯತೇ
ಯಸ್ಮೈ ಸ ತಾದೃಶಃ । ವಿಭೂತದ್ಯುಮ್ನಃ ಪ್ರಭೂತಯಶಾಃ ಪ್ರಭೂತಾನ್ನೋ ವಾ । ಏವಯಾ ರಕ್ಷಣಸ್ಯ
ಮಿಶ್ರಯಿತಾ ಪ್ರಾಪಯಿತಾ । ಸಪ್ರಥಾಃ ಸರ್ವತಃ ಪೃಥುಃ । ಪ್ರತಿವಿಶೇಷಣಂ ನೋ ಭವೇತಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಃ ॥
ದ್ವ್ಯಚೋಽತಸ್ತಿಜ ಇತಿ ದೀರ್ಘಃ । ಉ ಇತಿ ಪಾದಪೂರಣಃ ॥ ಹೇ ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ತ್ವಂ ಯಸ್ಮಾದೀವೃಶೋ
ಭವಸಿ ಅಧಾಸ್ಮಾತ್ತೇ ತವ ಸ್ತೋಮಃ ಸ್ತೋತ್ರವಿಶೇಷೋ ವಿದುಷಾ ತ್ವನ್ಮಾಹಾತ್ಮ್ಯವೇದಿತ್ರಾ ಯಜಮಾನೇನಾರ್ಧ್ಯಃ ಪುನಃ ಪುನಃ ಪ್ರವರ್ಧನಾರ್ಹಃ । ಏಕವಾರಕರಣೇ ನ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಯತ ಇತ್ಯರ್ಥಃ । ತಥಾ
ತೇ ಯಜ್ಞಶ್ಚ ಹವಿಷ್ಮತಾ ತೇನ ಯಜಮಾನೇನ ರಾಧ್ಯಃ ಸಮಾರಾಧನೀಯಃ । ಯದ್ವಾ । ವಿದುಷಾ
ಹೋತ್ರಾ ಸ್ತೋಮೋ ರಾಧ್ಯೋ ಹವಿಷ್ಮತಾ ಯಜ್ಞಶ್ಚ ರಾಧ್ಯಃ ॥

en: "O Viṣṇu, like Mitra": Mitra is the friend, the Āditya who saves from distress; he cites Nirukta 10-21, प्रमीतेस्त्रायत इति (*pramītestrāyata iti*). Like him, Viṣṇu is शेव्यः (*śevyaḥ*), good at giving happiness, the maker of happiness, and घृतासुतिः (*ghṛtāsutiḥ*) (continued in the next block).

घृतासुतिः (*ghṛtāsutiḥ*): he by whom water is pressed out; or else he to whom ghee is brought face to face. विभूतद्युम्नः (*vibhūtadyumnaḥ*): of abundant fame, or of abundant food. एवयाः (*evayāḥ*): the one who brings or bestows protection. सप्रथाः (*saprathāḥ*): broad on all sides. Each of these epithets is connected with "be to us". उ (*u*) is a verse-filler. O Viṣṇu, since you are such, therefore your स्तोमः (*stomaḥ*), a special praise, is अर्ध्यः (*ardhyaḥ*) for the knowing sacrificer who knows your greatness: fit to be furthered again and again; it is not completed by being done once. Likewise your sacrifice is राध्यः (*rādhyaḥ*), to be accomplished by that sacrificer who has the oblation. Or else: the praise is to be accomplished by the knowing Hotṛ, and the sacrifice by the sacrificer with the oblation.

kn: (ಎಲೈ ವಿಷ್ಣುವೇ) ಮಿತ್ರೋ ನ—ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನಂತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಮಿತ್ರರೂಪನಾದ ಆದಿತ್ಯನಂತೆ । ಶೇವ್ಯಃ—
ದ್ಯುಮ್ನಃ—ಪ್ರಭೂತವಾದ ಯಶಸ್ಸುಳ್ಳವನಾಗಿಯೂ ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರಭೂತವಾದ ಅನ್ನವುಳ್ಳವನಾಗಿಯೂ । ಏವಯಾಃರಕ್ಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ಕೊಡುವವನಾಗಿಯೂ । ಸಪ್ರಥಾಃ—ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಸುಗಮ್ಯನಾಗಿಯೂ । ಭವ—(ನಮ್ಮ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ)
ಆಗಿರು ! ವಿಷ್ಣೋ—ಎಲೈ ವಿಷ್ಣುವೇ । ಅಧ—ನೀನು ಈ ಗುಣಗಳಿಂದ ಪೂರಿತನಾಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದಲೇ । ತೇ—ನಿನ್ನ ।
ಸ್ತೋಮಃ—ವಿಶೇಷವಾದ ಸ್ತೋತ್ರವು । ವಿದುಷಾ—(ನಿನ್ನ ಮಾಹಾತ್ಮ್ಯವನ್ನು) ತಿಳಿದಿರುವ ಯಜಮಾನನಿಂದ ।
ಅರ್ಧ್ಯಃ—ಪುನಃ ಪುನಃ ಪಠಿತವಾಗತಕ್ಕದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ । ಯಜ್ಞಶ್ಚ—(ನಿನ್ನನ್ನು ಉದ್ದೇಶಿಸಿದ) ಯಾಗವೂ ಕೂಡ ।
en: - मित्रो न (*mitro na*)—like a friend, or like the Āditya in the form of Mitra
- धृतासुतिः (*dhṛtāsutiḥ*)—the accepter of the offering of ghee
- विभूतद्युम्नः (*vibhūtadyumnaḥ*)—having abundant fame, or abundant food
- अध (*adha*)—because you are filled with these qualities
- विदुषा (*viduṣā*)—by the sacrificer who knows (your greatness)
- अर्ध्यः (*ardhyaḥ*)—to be recited again and again
- हविष्मता (*haviṣmatā*)—by the sacrificer who has the oblation

kn: ಎಲೈ ವಿಷ್ಣುವೇ, ನಮಗೆ ನೀನು ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನಂತೆ ಸುಖವನ್ನುಂಟುಮಾಡುವವನಾಗಿಯೂ, ಆಜ್ಯಾಹುತಿ
ಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುವವನಾಗಿಯೂ, ಪ್ರಭೂತವಾದ ಯಶಸ್ಸುಳ್ಳವನಾಗಿಯೂ, ರಕ್ಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ಕೊಡುವವನಾಗಿಯೂ,
ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಸುಗಮ್ಯನಾಗಿಯೂ ಆಗಿರು ಎಲೈ ವಿಷ್ಣುವೇ, ನೀನು ಈ ಗುಣಗಳಿಂದ ಪೂರಿತನಾಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದಲೇ
ನಿನ್ನ ವಿಶೇಷವಾದ ಸ್ತೋತ್ರವು ನಿನ್ನ ಮಾಹಾತ್ಮ್ಯವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದಿರುವ ಯಜಮಾನನಿಂದ ಪುನಃ ಪುನಃ ಪಠಿತವಾಗತಕ್ಕ
ದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ. ಮತ್ತು ನಿನ್ನನ್ನು ಉದ್ದೇಶಿಸಿದ ಯಾಗವೂ ಕೂಡ ಹವಿಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಯಜಮಾನನಿಂದ ನೆರವೇರಿ
en: O Viṣṇu, be to us like a friend: the giver of happiness, the accepter of the ghee offering, of abundant fame, the giver of protection, and easily approachable on every side. O Viṣṇu, since you are filled with these qualities, your special praise is to be recited again and again by the sacrificer who knows your greatness; and the sacrifice directed to you is also to be accomplished by the sacrificer who has the oblation.

kn: Be (to us), Vishnu, like a friend, the giver of happiness, the accepter
of oblations, abounding with food, the granter of protection, and every way
accessible; on which account your praise is to be repeatedly recited by the
wise, and your worship to be celebrated by the offerer of oblations.
en: Be (to us), Vishnu, like a friend, the giver of happiness, the accepter of oblations, abounding with food, the granter of protection, and every way accessible; on which account your praise is to be repeatedly recited by the wise, and your worship to be celebrated by the offerer of oblations.

kn: ಈ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಷ್ಣುವನ್ನು ಮಿತ್ರನಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದೆ. ಮಿತ್ರಶಬ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ವಿಧವಾದ ಅರ್ಥ
ವನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದೆ. ಲೌಕಿಕವಾದ ಸಖನೆಂದಾಗಲಿ ಅಥವಾ ಆ ಸಖನ ಗುಣಗಳಿರತಕ್ಕ ಆದಿತ್ಯರೂಪನಾದ ಮಿತ್ರ
ನೆಂದಾಗಲಿ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗಬಹುದು. ಸಖನಿಂದ ಸುಖಸಂತೋಷಾದಿಗಳು ಯಾವ ರೀತಿ ಲಭಿಸುವುವೋ ಆದಿತ್ಯ
ರೂಪನಾದ ಮಿತ್ರನಿಂದಲೂ ಅದೇ ಉಪಕಾರಗಳು ಲೋಕಕ್ಕೆ ಲಭಿಸುವುವು ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುವಂತೆ ನಿರುಕ್ತಕಾರರು
ಮಿತ್ರಃ-ಮಿತ್ರಃ ಪ್ರಮೀತೇಸ್ತ್ರಾಯತೇ । ಸಂಮಿನ್ವಾನೋ ದ್ರವತೀತಿ ವಾ । ಮೇದಯತೇರ್ವಾ ।
ಅಥವಾ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ಆಹಾರಾದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಪೋಷಿಸಿ ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನು ಪುಷ್ಟವಾದುದನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದಾಗಲಿ
ಮಿತ್ರೋ ಜನಾನ್ಯಾತಯತಿ ಬ್ರುವಾಣೋ ಮಿತ್ರೋ ದಾಧಾರ ಪೃಥಿವೀಮುತ ದ್ಯಾಂ ।
ಮಿತ್ರಃ ಕೃಷ್ಣೀರನಿಮಿಷಾಭಿ ಚಷ್ಟೇ ಮಿತ್ರಾಯ ಹವ್ಯಂ ಧೃತವಜ್ಜು ಹೋತ ॥
ಎಂಬ ಋಕ್ಕನ್ನು ದಹರಿಸಿ ಮಿತ್ರನ ಹಿತಕರವಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿತ್ವವನ್ನೂ, ದ್ಯಾವಾಪೃಥಿವಿಗಳ ಧಾರಣಕ್ರಮವನ್ನೂ,
ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಜಾಗರೂಕನಾಗಿ ತನಗೆ ಸೇರಿದ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದನ್ನೂ ತಿಳಿಸಿ ಮಿತ್ರನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಆಪ್ತಮಿತ್ರನ
ಗುಣಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಿದೆ. ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಕೃತವಾದ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಸಹ ಶೇವ್ಯಃ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿವಿಶೇಷಣಗಳಿಂದ ಮಿತ್ರನ
ಶೇವ್ಯಃ—ಸಾಧುಃ ಸುಖಕರ್ತಾ । ಸುಖಕಾರಿಯು. ಶೇವವೆಂದರೆ ಸುಖವೆಂದರ್ಥ. ಯಜ್ಞಫಲವಾದ
ಸುಖವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ದೇಶಿಸುವ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧಾರಣವಾಗಿ ಈ ಪದದ ಪ್ರಯೋಗವಿದೆ.
ಯಜ್ಞ ಸಾಹಂ ದುವ ಇಷೇಗ್ನಿಂ ಪೂರ್ವಸ್ಯ ಶೇವಸ್ಯ । ಅದ್ರೇಃ ಸೂನುಮಾಯುಮಾಹುಃ ॥
ಎಂಬಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ಕೃಷ್ಟವಾದುದೂ ಯಜ್ಞಫಲರೂಪವಾದುದೂ ಆದ ಸುಖಪರ್ಯಾಯವಾಗಿ ಶೇವಪದವನ್ನು ಪ
ಯೋಗಿಸಿದೆ. ಪ್ರಕೃತವಾದ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಿತ್ರನ ಸ್ವರೂಪದ ವರ್ಣನೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಮಿತ್ರನು ಇಷ್ಟು
ಉತ್ತಮವಾದ ಸುಖವನ್ನುಂಟುಮಾಡುವವನೆಂದು ಹೇಳಿದೆ. ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷ್ಣುವನ್ನೂ ಇಂತಹ ಮಿತ್ರನಾಗಿರಬೇಕೆಂದು
ತ್ತದೆ. ಕ್ಷೀರಾದಿಗಳೂ, ಆಹುತಿರೂಪವಾದ ಸೋಮರಸವೂ ಅಥವಾ ಫೃತರೂಪವಾದ ಆಹುತಿಯೂ ಆಸುತಿಶಬ್ದ
ತ್ವೇ ಅಗ್ನೇ ವಿಶ್ವೇ ಅಮೃತಾಸೋ ಅದ್ರುಹ ಆಸಾ ದೇವಾ ಹವಿರದಂತ್ಯಾಹುತಿಂ ।
ತ್ವಯಾ ಮರ್ತಾಸಃ ಸ್ವದಂತ ಆಸುತಿಂ ತ್ವಂ ಗರ್ಭೋ ವೀರುಧಾಂ ಜಜ್ಜಿಷೇ ಶುಚಿಃ ॥
ಎಂಬಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗ್ನಿಯ ಅನುಗ್ರಹದಿಂದ ಮಾನವರು ರಸರೂಪವಾದ ಕ್ಷೀರಾದ್ಯನ್ನಗಳನ್ನು ಭೋಗಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳು
ವಾಗ ಕ್ಷೀರಾದಿಗಳ ಪರ್ಯಾಯವಾಗಿ ಆಸುತಿ ಶಬ್ದವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿದೆ. ಪ್ರಕೃತವಾದ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಧೃತರೂಪವಾದ
ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರಭೂತವಾದ ಅನ್ನವುಳ್ಳವನೆಂದರ್ಥ. ದ್ಯುಮ್ನ ಶಬ್ದವನ್ನು ನಿರುಕ್ತಕಾರರು ಧನನಾಮಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಸಿ
ದ್ದಾರೆ. (ನಿ. ೩-೯). ಅಲ್ಲದೇ ಪುನಃ ಈ ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ನಿರ್ವಚನವನ್ನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾ, ದ್ಯುಮ್ನಂ ದ್ಯೋತತೇರ‍್ಯಶೋ ವಾ
ಅನ್ನಂ ವಾ (ನಿ ೫-೫) ಪ್ರಕಾಶಮಾನವಾಗು ಎಂಬರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಕೊಡುವ ದ್ಯುತ್ ಧಾತುವಿನಿಂದ ನಿಷ್ಪನ್ನವಾಗಿ
ಶತಂ ತೇ ಶಿಪ್ರಿನ್ನೂ ತಯಃ ಸುದಾಸೇ ಸಹಸ್ರಂ ಶಂಸಾ ಉತ ರಾತಿರಸ್ತು ।
ಜಹಿ ವಧರ್ವನುಷೋ ಮರ್ತ್ಯಸ್ಯಾಸ್ಮೇ ದ್ಯುಮ್ನಮಧಿ ರತ್ನಂ ಚ ಧೇಹಿ ॥
ಎಂಬ ಋಕ್ಕನ್ನುದಹರಿಸಿ ನಮಗೆ ದ್ಯುಮ್ನವನ್ನೂ ರತ್ನವನ್ನೂ ಕೊಡು ಎಂದು ಪ್ರಾರ್ಥಿಸುವಾಗ ರತ್ನಶಬ್ದದಿಂದ
ಧನವು ಸೂಚಿತವಾಗಿ ದ್ಯುಮ್ನವೆಂದರೆ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಅಥವಾ ಅನ್ನವೆಂದರ್ಥವಾಗುತ್ತದೆಂದು ತೋರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. (ನಿ. ೫-೫)
ಅದರಂತೆಯೇ ಪ್ರಕೃತವಾದ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಪ್ರಭೂತವಾದ ಯಶಸ್ಸುಳ್ಳವನು ಅಥವಾ ಅನ್ನವುಳ್ಳವನೆಂದರ್ಥ.
ಏವಯಾಃ—ಈ ಪದವು ಸಾಧಾರಣವಾಗಿ ಮರುತ್ತುಗಳಿಗೆ ವಿಶೇಷಣವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಏವೈಃ ಸಖಿಭಿಃ—
ಗಮನಶೀಲೈರ್ಮಿತ್ರಭೂತೈರ್ಮರುದ್ಭಿಃ ಎಂದು ಅನೇಕಕಡೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮರುತ್ತುಗಳ ಸಂಚಾರಸ್ವಭಾವವನ್ನೂ ಯಾ
ವಾಗಲೂ ಒಡಗೂಡಿ ಇರುವುದನ್ನೂ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೂಲಧಾತುವಿಗೆ ಸಂಚಾರಾರ್ಥವಿದ್ದರೂ ಪ್ರಕೃತವಾದ ಋಕ್ಕಿ
ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಿಶ್ರಯಿತಾ ಯೋಜಿಸತಕ್ಕವನು ಎಂದರೆ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸಿಕೊಡುವವನು ಎಂದು ತಾತ್ಪರ್ಯವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
ಸಪ್ರಥಾಃ—ಸರ್ವತಃ ಪೃಥುಃ । ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ವಿಸ್ತ್ರತವಾಗಿ ಹರಡಿರುವುದು ಎಂದು ನಿರುಕ್ತಕಾರರು
ತ್ವಮಗ್ನೇ ಸಪ್ರಥಾ ಅಸಿ ಜುಷ್ಟೋ ಹೋತಾ ವರೇಣ್ಯಃ । ತ್ವಯಾ ಯಜ್ಞಂ ವಿ ತನ್ವತೇ ॥
ಎಂಬ ಋಕ್ಕನ್ನು ದಹರಿಸಿ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಉಚಿತವಾದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಮೇಲೆ ಹೇಳಿದಂತೆ ತೋರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಆದರೆ
ಪ್ರಕೃತವಾದ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಅರ್ಥವು ಕೊಂಚ ವಿಸ್ತ್ರತವಾಗಿದೆ. ನಮ್ಮ ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಬೃಹಚ್ಛರೀರನಾಗಿರು ಎಂಬುದ
ಅಧ್ಯಃ—ಪುನಃ ಪುನಃ ಪ್ರವರ್ಧನಾರ್ಹಃ । ಏಕವಾರಕರಣೇ ನ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣತ ಇತ್ಯರ್ಥಃ !
ನಿನ್ನನ್ನು ಸ್ತುತಿಸತಕ್ಕ ಸ್ತೋಮರೂಪವಾದ ಸ್ತೋತ್ರವು ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಪಠಿಸಿ ನಿನ್ನ ಗುಣಗಾನವನ್ನು ಮಾಡತಕ್ಕ
en: In this Ṛk Vishnu is compared to Mitra. The word Mitra is explained here in two ways: it may mean the worldly friend, or Mitra in the form of Āditya, who has the qualities of that friend. To show that the same benefits of happiness and joy that come from a friend come to the world from Mitra in the form of Āditya, the Nirukta-writer has given a derivation of this word—
मित्रः प्रमीतेस्त्रायते । संमिन्वानो द्रवतीति वा । मेदयतेर्वा । (*mitraḥ pramītestrāyate | saṃminvāno dravatīti vā | medayatervā |*)

Yāska explains that the name Mitra arises either from protecting from destruction, or from moving about while measuring (examining) all principles, or from nourishing the world by giving it food and the like and so making the world well-fed. (Ni. 10-21) And further, he quotes the Ṛk

मित्रो जनान्यातयति ब्रुवाणो मित्रो दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्यां । मित्रः कृष्णीरनिमिषाभि चष्टे मित्राय हव्यं धृतवज्जु होत ॥ (*mitro janānyātayati bruvāṇo mitro dādhāra pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ | mitraḥ kṛṣṇīranimiṣābhi caṣṭe mitrāya havyaṃ dhṛtavajju hota ‖*)

and, by showing Mitra's beneficial guidance, the manner in which he upholds heaven and earth, and his being ever watchful and protecting the people who belong to him, he explains the qualities of a trusted friend found in Mitra. In the present Ṛk also, Mitra's nature is described by the epithets beginning with शेव्यः (*śevyaḥ*).

शेव्यः (*śevyaḥ*)—साधुः सुखकर्ता (*sādhuḥ sukhakartā*): one who gives happiness. शेव (*śeva*) means happiness. This word is generally used when the happiness that is the fruit of sacrifice is indicated.
यज्ञ साहं दुव इषेग्निं पूर्वस्य शेवस्य । अद्रेः सूनुमायुमाहुः ॥ (*yajña sāhaṃ duva iṣegniṃ pūrvasya śevasya | adreḥ sūnumāyumāhuḥ ‖*)

Here the word शेव (*śeva*) is used as a synonym for happiness that is excellent and is the fruit of sacrifice. In the present Ṛk, in describing Mitra's nature, it is said that Mitra produces happiness of such excellence; and Vishnu too is prayed to be such a Mitra.

फृतासुतिं (*phṛtāsutiṃ*)—it means an āsuti in the form of ghee. Āsuti means food in the form of juice; milk and the like, the Soma juice that is an oblation, or an oblation in the form of ghee, are all indicated by the word āsuti.

त्वे अग्ने विश्वे अमृतासो अद्रुह आसा देवा हविरदंत्याहुतिं । त्वया मर्तासः स्वदंत आसुतिं त्वं गर्भो वीरुधां जज्जिषे शुचिः ॥ (*tve agne viśve amṛtāso adruha āsā devā haviradaṃtyāhutiṃ | tvayā martāsaḥ svadaṃta āsutiṃ tvaṃ garbho vīrudhāṃ jajjiṣe śuciḥ ‖*)

Here, saying that by Agni's grace men enjoy foods such as milk, in the form of juice, the word āsuti is used as a synonym of milk and the like. In the present Ṛk it means an āsuti in the form of ghee.

विभूतद्युम्नः (*vibhūtadyumnaḥ*)—प्रभूतयशाः प्रभूतान्नो वा (*prabhūtayaśāḥ prabhūtānno vā*): one of abundant fame, or one of abundant food. The Nirukta-writers have included the word द्युम्न (*dyumna*) among the names of wealth (Ni. 3-9). Moreover, when giving a derivation of this word again, द्युम्नं द्योततेर‍्यशो वा अन्नं वा (*dyumnaṃ dyotateryaśo vā annaṃ vā*) (Ni. 5-5), they show that, formed from the root द्युत् (*dyut*) meaning "to shine", it means either fame or food. Quoting the Ṛk

शतं ते शिप्रिन्नू तयः सुदासे सहस्रं शंसा उत रातिरस्तु । जहि वधर्वनुषो मर्त्यस्यास्मे द्युम्नमधि रत्नं च धेहि ॥ (*śataṃ te śiprinnū tayaḥ sudāse sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta rātirastu | jahi vadharvanuṣo martyasyāsme dyumnamadhi ratnaṃ ca dhehi ‖*)

they show that, when the prayer is made "give us द्युम्न (*dyumna*) and treasure", wealth is indicated by the word रत्न (*ratna*), and so द्युम्न (*dyumna*) means fame or food. (Ni. 5-5) Likewise in the present Ṛk it means one of abundant fame or of abundant food.

एवयाः (*evayāḥ*)—this word is generally an epithet of the Maruts. In many places, as in एवैः सखिभिः (*evaiḥ sakhibhiḥ*)—गमनशीलैर्मित्रभूतैर्मरुद्भिः (*gamanaśīlairmitrabhūtairmarudbhiḥ*), it indicates the Maruts' nature of moving about and their being always together. Although the root has the sense of moving, in the present Ṛk the sense is "one who unites, who joins", that is, one who provides protection.
सप्रथाः (*saprathāḥ*)—सर्वतः पृथुः (*sarvataḥ pṛthuḥ*): spread widely all around. The Nirukta-writers explained the basic meaning of this word thus (Ni. 6-8),
त्वमग्ने सप्रथा असि जुष्टो होता वरेण्यः । त्वया यज्ञं वि तन्वते ॥ (*tvamagne saprathā asi juṣṭo hotā vareṇyaḥ | tvayā yajñaṃ vi tanvate ‖*)

and quoting this Ṛk they showed the fitting meaning of the word there as stated above. In the present Ṛk, however, that meaning is somewhat extended: the commentator explains the purport as "be large-bodied all around us".

अध्यः (*adhyaḥ*)—पुनः पुनः प्रवर्धनार्हः । एकवारकरणे न संपूर्णत इत्यर्थः ! (*punaḥ punaḥ pravardhanārhaḥ | ekavārakaraṇe na saṃpūrṇata ityarthaḥ !*) The stoma-hymn that praises you is to be recited again and again, to sing your qualities; it is not to be finished by reciting once. This is the meaning.
राध्यः (*rādhyaḥ*)—समाराधनीयः (*samārādhanīyaḥ*): one to be performed with splendour.

kn: ಭವ—ಭೂ ಸತ್ತಾಯಾಂ ಧಾತು. ಲೋಟ್ ಮಧ್ಯಮಪುರುಷಏಕವಚನಾಂತರೂಪ. ದ್ವಚೋತಸ್ತಿಜ-
(ಪಾ. ಸೂ. ೬-೩-೧೩೫) ಎಂಬುದರಿಂದ ಸಂಹಿತಾದಲ್ಲಿ ದೀರ್ಘ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ಪಾದಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ನಿಘಾತ
ಸ್ವರ ಬರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಶಪ್ ಪಿತ್ತಾದುದರಿಂದ ಧಾತುಸ್ವರ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
ಮಿತ್ರಃ—ಇಮಿದಾ ಸ್ನೇಹನೇ ಧಾತು. ಅಮಿಜಿಮಿ - (ಉ. ಸೂ. ೪.೬೦-೩) ಎಂಬುದರಿಂದ ಕ್ರ
ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ- ಕಿತ್ತಾದುದರಿಂದ ಲಘೂಪಧಗುಣ ಬರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯಸ್ವರದಿಂದ ಅಂತೋದಾತ್ತವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
ಶೇವ್ಯಃ—ಶೇವೇ ಸಾಧುಃ ಶೇವ್ಯಃ. ಸಾರ್ಧ್ವರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಯತ್ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ. ಯತೋನಾವಃ (ಪಾ. ಸೂ.
ಧೃತಾಸುತಿಃ—ಧೃತಂ ಆಸುತಿಃ ಯೇನ ಸಃ ಧೃತಾಸುತಿಃ ಬಹುವ್ರೀಹಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ವಪದಪ್ರಕೃತಿಸ್ವರ
ಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಭೂತದ್ಯುಮ್ನಃ ಎಂಬಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಬಹುವ್ರೀಹಿಸಮಾಸವಾದುದರಿಂದ ಪೂರ್ವಪದಪ್ರಕೃತಿಸ್ವರ ಬರುತ್ತದೆಸಪ್ರಥಾಃ—ಪ್ರಥ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾನೇ ಧಾತು. ಸರ್ವಧಾತುಭ್ಯಃ ಅಸುನ್ ಎಂಬುದರಿಂದ ಅಸುನ್ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ.
ಪ್ರಥಸಾ ಸಹ ವರ್ತತೇ ಇತಿ ಸಪ್ರಥಾಃ ತೇನ ಸಹೇತಿ ತುಲ್ಯಯೋಗೇ (ಪಾ. ಸೂ. ೨-೨-೨೮) ಎಂಬುದರಿಂದ

ಅಧಾ—ಅಥ ಎಂಬಲ್ಲಿ ಛಾಂದಸವಾಗಿ ವರ್ಣವಿಕಾರ ಬಂದಿದೆ. ನಿಪಾತಸ್ಯಚ (ಪಾ ಸೂ. ೬-೩-೧೩೬)

en: - भव—भू सत्तायां धातुः । लोट् मध्यमपुरुषएकवचनांतरूपम् । द्वचोतस्तिज- (पा. सू. ६-३-१३५) इति संहितायां दीर्घो भवति । पादादित्वान्निघातस्वरो न भवति । शप् पित्त्वाद्धातुस्वरो अवशिष्यते ।
- मित्रः—इमिदा स्नेहने धातुः । अमिजिमि- (उ. सू. ४.६०-३) इति क्र प्रत्ययः । कित्त्वाल्लघूपधगुणो न भवति । प्रत्ययस्वरेणांतोदात्तो भवति । ⟨NOTE:430⟩
- शेव्यः—शेवे साधुः शेव्यः । साध्वर्थे यत् प्रत्ययः । यतोनावः (पा. सू. ६-१-२१३) इत्याद्युदात्तस्वरो भवति ।
- धृतासुतिः—धृतं आसुतिः येन सः धृतासुतिः । बहुव्रीहौ पूर्वपदप्रकृतिस्वरो भवति । विभूतद्युम्नः इत्यत्रापि बहुव्रीहिसमासत्वात् पूर्वपदप्रकृतिस्वरो भवति ।

- सप्रथाः—प्रथ प्रख्याने धातुः । सर्वधातुभ्यः असुन् इत्यसुन् प्रत्ययः । प्रथसा सह वर्तते इति सप्रथाः । तेन सहेति तुल्ययोगे (पा. सू. २-२-२८) इति समासः । वोपसर्जनस्य (पा. सू. ६-२-८२) इति सह इत्यस्य समासे स भावः । ⟨NOTE:431⟩
- अधा—अथ इत्यत्र छांदसत्वाद्वर्णविकारो जातः । निपातस्यच (पा सू. ६-३-१३६) इति संहितायां दीर्घो भवति ।
- विदुषा—विद ज्ञाने धातुः । अस्माल्लट् आगते तस्य शत्रादेशः । विदेशिशतुर्वसुः (पा. सू. ७-१-३६) इति शतृवसुरादेशः । तृतीयाविकवचने परे वसोः संप्रसारणम् इति संप्रसारणं पूर्वरूपम् ।
- अध्यः—ऋधु वृद्धौ धातुः । अस्मादर्हार्थे यत् आगते धातोर्लघूपधस्य गुणः । आद्युदात्तस्वरो भवति । एवमेव राध संसिद्धौ धातुः । अस्मादपि यत् आगते आद्युदात्तस्वरो भवति ॥ १ ॥

en: "He who" (यः (*yaḥ*)), the mortal, to the one who is पूर्व (*pūrva*), of former time, that is, eternal; वेधसे (*vedhase*), the maker of the manifold world; नवीयसे (*navīyase*), ever new, that is, exceedingly delightful, or else worthy of praise; सुमज्ञानये (*sumajñānaye*), born of himself (the suffix is Uṇādi इण् (*iṇ*)), "self-existent" (*sumatsyayam*), Ni. 6-22, says Yāska. Or else: सुतरां मादयतीति सुमत् (*sutarāṃ mādayatīti sumat*), one whose wife is of such a kind is so called; thus, to the lord of Śrī, whose nature is to gladden the whole world. In this case the substitute निज् (*nij*) is a samāsānta by Pā. 5-4-134, and the व (*va*) is elided. To Vishnu, the all-pervading, who has the stated qualities, "he gives" (ददाशति (*dadāśati*)) oblations and the like. Moreover, of this great Vishnu, of great majesty, he would proclaim (ब्रवत् (*bravat*), i.e. would celebrate; the *aṭ* augment of the Leṭ of ब्रू (*brū*)) the great, worshipful birth (जातं (*jātaṃ*)), the birth in the form of Hiraṇyagarbha and the like. सेदु (*sedu*): the word उ (*u*) has the sense of "also"; he too, the giver and the praiser, endowed with श्रवः (*śravaḥ*) (food, or fame), reaches (*abhyasat*: goes, attains) that place which is to be reached by all (युज्यं चित् (*yujyaṃ cit*)), facing it directly.

kn: ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿಗೆ ಪತಿಯಾಗಿಯೂ ಇರುವ । ವಿಷ್ಣವೇ—ಸರ್ವವ್ಯಾಪಕನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿಗೆ । ದದಾಶತಿ—(ಹವಿರಾದಿಗಳನ್ನು)
ಅರ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆಯೋ । (ಮತ್ತು) ಮಹತಃ ಅಸ್ಯ—ಮಹಾತ್ಮನಾದ ಈ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ । ಮಹಿ—ಅದ್ಭುತವಾದ ಮತ್ತು
(ಹೀಗೆ ದಾತೃವೂ ಸ್ತೋತೃವೂ ಆಗಿರುವ) ಅವನೂ ಕೂಡ । ಶ್ರವೋಭಿಃ—ಅನ್ನಗಳಿಂದ ಅಥವಾ ಕೀರ್ತಿಗಳಿಂದ
ಕೂಡಿಕೊಂಡು । ಯುಜ್ಯಂಚಿತ್—(ಎಲ್ಲರೂ) ಹೋಗಿಸೇರಬೇಕಾದ ಆ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ಸಾನ್ನಿಧ್ಯವನ್ನು । ಅಭಿ—
ಯಾವ ಮಾನವನು ನಿತ್ಯನಾಗಿಯೂ, ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುವವನಾಗಿಯೂ, ರಮಣೀಯನಾಗಿಯೂ,
ತಾನಾಗಿಯೇ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನನಾಗಿಯೂ ಇರುವ ಸರ್ವವ್ಯಾಪಕನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿಗೆ ಹವಿರಾದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಅರ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆಯೋ,
ಮತ್ತು ಮಹಾತ್ಮನಾದ ಈ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ಅದ್ಭುತವಾದ ಹಿರಣ್ಯಗರ್ಭಾದಿ ರೂಪವಾದ ಜನ್ಮವನ್ನು ಹೊಗಳುತ್ತಾನೆಯೋ
ಹೀಗೆ ದಾತೃವೂ ಸ್ತೋತೃವೂ ಆಗಿರುವ ಅವನೂ ಕೂಡ ಕೀರ್ತಿಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿಕೊಂಡು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೋಗಿ ಸೇರಬೇಕಾದ
en: - पूर्व्याय (*pūrvyāya*)—to the ancient, that is, the eternal
- वेधसे (*vedhase*)—to the creator of the world
- नवीयसे (*navīyase*)—to the delightful one, because he is new
- सुमज्ञानये (*sumajñānaye*)—to him who is self-born, or who is the husband of Lakshmi, who gives joy to the whole world
- महतः अस्य (*mahataḥ asya*)—of this great-souled Vishnu
- जातं (*jātaṃ*)—the birth in the form of Hiraṇyagarbha and the like
- सेदु (*sedu*)—he also (who is thus giver and praiser)
- श्रवोभिः (*śravobhiḥ*)—endowed with foods or with fames
- युज्यंचित् (*yujyaṃcit*)—the presence of that Vishnu, to which (all) must go and unite

kn: He who presents (offerings) to Vishnu, the ancient, the creator, the recent, the self-born ; he who celebrates the great birth of that mighty one : he verily possessed of abundance, attains (the station) that is to be sought (by all)-

kn: ಸುಮಜ್ಞಾನಯೇ—ಈ ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ವಿಧವಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಮೊದಲನೆಯದಾಗಿ, ಸ್ವಯ

ಸುಮತ್ । ತಾದೃಶೀ ಜಾಯಾ ಯಸ್ಯ ಸ ತಥೋಕ್ತಃ । ಸರ್ವಜಗನ್ಮಾದನಶೀಲಶ್ರೀಪತಯೇ । ಸುಮತ್

en: सुमज्ञानये (*sumajñānaye*)—This word is explained in two ways. First, स्वयमेवोत्पन्नाय (*svayamevotpannāya*): to (Vishnu) who is self-born. Second, सुतरां मादयतीति सुमत् । तादृशी जाया यस्य स तथोक्तः । सर्वजगन्मादनशीलश्रीपतये । (*sutarāṃ mādayatīti sumat | tādṛśī jāyā yasya sa tathoktaḥ | sarvajaganmādanaśīlaśrīpataye |*) Taking the word सुमत् (*sumat*) as "bringing delight", the explanation given is: husband of the goddess Lakshmi, who has such a delight-giving quality and gives joy to all the worlds.
सुमत्स्ययमित्यर्थः । (*sumatsyayamityarthaḥ |*) (Ni. 6-22): saying that सुमत् (*sumat*) means "of oneself, spontaneously", he quotes

उप प्रागात्सुमन्मेधायि मन्म देवानामाशा उप वीतपृष्ठः । अन्वेनं विप्रा ऋषयो मदंति देवानां पुष्टे चकृमा सुबंधुं ॥ (*upa prāgātsumanmedhāyi manma devānāmāśā upa vītapṛṣṭhaḥ | anvenaṃ viprā ṛṣayo madaṃti devānāṃ puṣṭe cakṛmā subaṃdhuṃ ‖*)

and, quoting this Ṛk, explains the prayer उपप्रैतु मां स्वयं । (*upapraitu māṃ svayaṃ |*) "may the object I desire come near me of itself", and so shows the meaning that the word सुमत् (*sumat*) has. On this basis it can be said that the sense "self-born" is fitting. Moreover, since in this same Ṛk the word जातं (*jātaṃ*) is explained as जन्म उत्पत्तिं हिरण्यगर्भादिरूपं (*janma utpattiṃ hiraṇyagarbhādirūpaṃ*), referring to origination in the form of Hiraṇyagarbha and the like, this meaning gains still more support. Or again, since the word सुमत् (*sumat*) is used in many places as a synonym of कल्याण (*kalyāṇa*), शोभन (*śobhana*) or भद्र (*bhadra*) (auspicious, beautiful), it would not be wrong to give the second meaning. Just as in सुमज्ञानिः (*sumajñāniḥ*), in places such as सुमद्गणः (*sumadgaṇaḥ*), सुमदंशु (*sumadaṃśu*), सुमद्रथः (*sumadrathaḥ*) the word सुमत् (*sumat*) has everywhere been given the sense of beautiful or auspicious, as shown with examples in the Special Topics of Ṛk 1-142-7 of this same volume (page 254). (In the Ṛk 1-142-7 the word there means simply "of itself".) However, the epithet श्रीपति (*śrīpati*) for Vishnu does not seem to occur in the Ṛgveda Saṃhitā. The word श्रीः (*śrīḥ*) has the meanings wealth and splendour, but not the conventional name Lakshmi. Therefore the first meaning is the more fitting.

जातं (*jātaṃ*)—हिरण्यगर्भादिरूपं जन्म । (*hiraṇyagarbhādirūpaṃ janma |*) It is described in the Ṛgveda Saṃhitā itself that, desiring the creation of the world, the divine principle first came into being of itself in forms such as Hiraṇyagarbha and afterwards created the world.

हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत् । स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥ (*hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt | sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ‖*)

In Ṛks of this kind it is said हिरण्यगर्भः जातमात्र एव जगतः ईश्वरः आसीत् (*hiraṇyagarbhaḥ jātamātra eva jagataḥ īśvaraḥ āsīt*); the same point is stated here too, praising Vishnu's beginningless nature and greatness.

वेधसे (*vedhase*)—विविधजगत्कर्त्रॆ । (*vividhajagatkartrè |*) It means: who created the world in its many forms. The word वेधस् (*vedhas*) is read in the Nirukta among the names of the wise (Ni. 3-19). It is generally an epithet of the wise sacrificer. In some places, even where the sense "producer" occurs, it can only mean producer of the fruit of sacrifice; its use for a creator of the world does not seem to occur. But in the present Ṛk, since words such as सुमज्ञानये (*sumajñānaye*) and जातं (*jātaṃ*) describe the nature of the world-creator, this word may fit the meaning Sāyaṇa gives, in keeping with the context.

पूर्व्याय नवीयसे (*pūrvyāya navīyase*)—these epithets speak at one and the same time of Vishnu's beginninglessness, his perpetual newness, and therefore his endlessness. For the word नवीयसे (*navīyase*) Sāyaṇa
Sāyaṇa explains the word *navīyase* as नित्यनूतनाय अत्यंतरमणीयाय (*nityanūtanāya atyaṃtaramaṇīyāya*), that is, "supremely delightful because he is ever new".

The description of Viṣṇu in the same order of words is given in the Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa as well (3-4-3-9) ⟨NOTE:432⟩. There Sāyaṇa explains the word पूर्वार्यय (*pūrvāryaya*) ⟨NOTE:433⟩ as जगतः पूर्वमेव भवाय (*jagataḥ pūrvameva bhavāya*), "who existed even before the creation of the world". He explains *navīyase* as रामकृष्णाद्यवतारैरत्यंतं नूतनाय (*rāmakṛṣṇādyavatārairatyaṃtaṃ nūtanāya*), "who is ever new through his forms of incarnation, Rāma, Kṛṣṇa and the rest".

*śravobhir yujyaṃ cid abhyasat*: Sāyaṇa explains this part in one way in the Ṛksaṃhitā and in another in the Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa (2-4-3-9). In the Saṃhitā: श्रवोभिः— अन्नैः कीर्तिभिर्वा युक्तःसन् (*śravobhiḥ— annaiḥ kīrtibhirvā yuktaḥsan*), युज्यं चित्— सर्वैर्गंतव्यमेव तत्पदं (*yujyaṃ cit— sarvairgaṃtavyameva tatpadaṃ*), अभ्यसत्— अभिमुख्येन गच्छति प्राप्नोति (*abhyasat— abhimukhyena gacchati prāpnoti*). That is, endowed with foods or with fame, he goes towards and reaches the supreme state that must be reached by all. In the Brāhmaṇa: श्रवोभिः—श्रवणीयैर्हविर्दानमंत्र्यैः स्तोत्रविशेषैश्च युज्यंचित् सर्वदा स्वेन युक्तमपि कामक्रोधलोभरूपं शत्रुं अभ्यसत्—अभितः निरस्यति ॥ (*śravobhiḥ—śravaṇīyairhavirdānamaṃtryaiḥ stotraviśeṣaiśca yujyaṃcit sarvadā svena yuktamapi kāmakrodhalobharūpaṃ śatruṃ abhyasat—abhitaḥ nirasyati ‖*). That is, with the mantras recited audibly while offering oblations and with special hymns, he drives far away the enemy in the form of desire, anger and greed, which clings to oneself.

Further, quoting the verse त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं (*trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ*) (भंगी (*bhaṃgī*)), he explains that the three kinds of enemies described there are *nirasyati*, driven out; this is the purport he gives for the mantra in the Brāhmaṇa.

Since the word *śravas* has the meanings food, strength, hymn and so on, either meaning may be given. But it is noted that the particle *cit* is used in other senses too. In the interpretation of the Saṃhitā, युज्यंचित् (*yujyaṃcit*) stresses the sense of excellence, सर्वैर्गंतव्यमेव (*sarvairgaṃtavyameva*), "that which all must attain". In the Brāhmaṇa sentence स्वेन युक्तमति (*svena yuktamati*) it gives the sense of something to be rejected, "even though clinging to oneself".

Since there is a Nirukta statement चिदित्येषोऽनेककर्मा (*cidityeṣo 'nekakarmā*) (1-4), this particle can be interpreted according to context. For example, in the sentence आचारश्चिदिदं ब्रूयात् (*ācāraścididaṃ brūyāt*) ("the teacher himself should say this; others cannot") the particle is used in the sense of honour (पूजायां (*pūjāyāṃ*)); in दधिचिदित्युपमार्थे (*dadhicidityupamārthe*) ("like curds") as a word of comparison; and in कुल्माषाश्चिदाहर (*kulmāṣāścidāhara*) ("bring even sour gruel") a sense of contempt is possible. This is explained in the Nirukta
. In the present mantra Sāyaṇa gives this particle the sense of honour in the Saṃhitā and the sense of contempt in the Brāhmaṇa.

अभ्यसत्—आभिमुख्येन गच्छति (*abhyasat—ābhimukhyena gacchati*): in the Saṃhitā he explains that he goes towards the supreme state; in the Brāhmaṇa he explains that the preposition *abhi* joins the root *as*, which gives the sense "throw", and so means "he destroys".

en: - वेधसे — वि उपसर्गः । डुधाञ् धारणपोषणयोः धातुः । विधाञ्नो वेधच (उ. सू. ४-६६४) इति असि प्रत्ययः । उपसर्गविशिष्टधातोः वेधादेशः । प्रत्ययस्य आद्युदात्तस्वरः भवति । चतुर्थीएकवचनांतरूपम् ।
- नवीयसे — अतिशयेन नवः नवीयान् । अतिशयार्थे ईयसुन् प्रत्ययः । इत्यादिर्नित्यम् इति आद्युदात्तस्वरः भवति ।

- सुमज्ञानये — सुमत् स्वयं जानिः उत्पत्तिः यस्य । सुमत्‌स्वयमित्यर्थः (निरु. ६-२२) इति यास्केन उक्तम् । जनी प्रादुर्भावे धातुः । अस्मात् औणादिकः इण् प्रत्ययः । अतउपधायाः (पा. सू. ७-२-११६) इति उपधावृद्धिः । सुमज्ञानि इति रूपं भवति । अथवा सुतरां मादयति इति सुमत् । सु उपपदे सति अंतर्भावितण्यर्थकात् मद धातोः क्विप् प्रत्ययः । सुमत् जाया यस्य सः सुमज्ञानिः । जायाया निज् (पा.सू. ५-४-१३४) इति समासांतत्वेन निजादेशः भवति । लोपोव्योर्वलि इति यकारलोपः । बहुव्रिह प्रकृत्या पूर्वपदम् (पा सू. ६-२-२) इति पूर्वपदप्रकृतिस्वरः भवति ।

- ददाशति — दाश्य दाने धातुः । भ्यादिः । लट् प्रथमपुरुषएकवचने परे बहुलं छंदसि इति शपि श्लु आदेशः । श्लु इति धातोः द्वित्वम् । यद्योगात् निघातस्वरः न भवति । अभ्यस्तासामादिः (पा सू. ६-१-१८९) इति आद्युदात्तस्वरः भवति ।
- महतः — बृहन्महतोरुपसंख्यानम् इति वचनेन षष्ठीविभक्तेः उदात्तस्वरः भवति ।
- महि — मह पूजायां धातुः । सर्वधातुभ्य इन् इति इन् प्रत्ययः । नित्त्वात् आद्युदात्तस्वरः भवति ।

- ब्रवत् — ब्रूञ् व्यक्तायां वाचि धातुः । लेट् प्रथमपुरुषएकवचने तिप् प्रत्ययः । इतश्चलोपः परस्मैपदेषु (पा. सू. ३-४-९७) इति इकारलोपः । लेटोऽडाटा (पा सू. ३-४-९४) इति तस्य अडागमः । अदिप्रभृतिभ्यः शपः (पा. सू. २-४-७२) इति शपो लुक् । प्रत्ययनिमित्तेन धातोः इको गुणः अवादेशः । यच्छब्दसंबंधात् निघातस्वरः न भवति । तिप् पित्त्वात् आगमस्यापि अनुदात्तत्वात् धातुस्वरः अवशिष्यते ।
- श्रवोभिः — श्रु श्रवणे धातुः । अस्मात् औणादिकः असुन् प्रत्ययः । नित्त्वात् आद्युदात्तस्वरः भवति । तृतीयाविकवचनांतरूपम् ।
- युज्यम् — युजिर् योगे धातुः । अस्मात् यत् प्रत्ययः । यतोनावः (पा. सू. ६-१-२१३) इति आद्युदात्तस्वरः भवति ।
- असत् — अस भुवि धातुः । लज् प्रथमपुरुषएकवचने तिप् । इतश्च इति इकारलोपः । बहुलं छंदसि इति शपो लुक् न भवति । तिजंतनिघातस्वरः भवति ।

The man who offers oblations and the like to Vishnu, the all-pervading, who is eternal, creator of the world, delightful, and self-born, and who praises the wonderful birth of this great-souled Vishnu in the form of Hiraṇyagarbha and the like — he, being both giver and praiser, endowed with fames, goes and joins the presence of that Vishnu, to which all must go.

kn: ತಮು ಸ್ತೋತಾರಃ ಪೂರ್ವ್ಯಂ ಯಥಾ ವಿದ ಋತಸ್ಯ ಗರ್ಭಂ ಜನುಷಾ
ಆಸ್ಯ ಜಾನಂತೋ ನಾಮ ಚಿದ್ವಿವಕ್ತನ ಮಹಸ್ತೇ ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ಸುಮತಿಂ
ref: तमु॑ स्तोतारः पू॒र्व्यं यथा॑ वि॒द ऋ॒तस्य॒ गर्भं॑ ज॒नुषा॑ पिपर्तन।
आस्य॑ जा॒नन्तो॒ नाम॑ चिद्विवक्तन म॒हस्ते॑ विष्णो सुम॒तिं भ॑जामहे

kn: ತಂ । ಊಂ ಇತಿ । ಸ್ತೋತಾರಃ । ಪೂರ್ವ್ಯಂ । ಯಥಾ । ವಿದ । ಋತಸ್ಯ । ಗರ್ಭಂ । ಜನುಷಾ ।
ಆ । ಅಸ್ಯ । ಜಾನಂತಃ । ನಾಮ । ಚಿತ್ । ವಿವಕ್ತನ । ಮಹಃ । ತೇ । ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ಇತಿ । ಸುಮತಿಂ ।
ಹೇ ಸ್ತೋತಾರಃ ತಮು ತಮೇವ ವಿಷ್ಣುಂ ಪೂರ್ವ್ಯಂ ಪೂರ್ವಾಹ್ನಮನಾದಿಸಂಸಿದ್ಧಮೃತಸ್ಯ
ಗರ್ಭಂ ಯಜ್ಞಸ್ಯ ಗರ್ಭಭೂತಂ । ಯಜ್ಞಾತ್ಮನೋತ್ಪನ್ನಮಿತ್ಯರ್ಥಃ । ಯಜ್ಞೋ ವೈ ವಿಷ್ಣುಃ । ಶತ.
೧-೧-೨-೧೩ । ಇತಿ ಶ್ರುತೇಃ । ಯದ್ವಾ । ಋತಸ್ಯೋದಕಸ್ಯ ಗರ್ಭಂ ಗರ್ಭಕಾರಣಂ । ಉವಕೋತ್ಪಾದಕಮಿತ್ಯರ್ಥಃ ॥ ಅಪ ಏವ ಸಸರ್ಜಾದೌ । ಮನು ೧-೮ । ಇತಿ ಸ್ಮೃತೇಃ । ಏವಂಭೂತಂ ವಿಷ್ಣುಂ ಯಥಾ
ವಿದ ಜಾನೀಥ ತಥಾ ಜನುಷಾ ಜನ್ಮನಾ ಸ್ವತ ಏವ ನ ಕೇನಚಿದ್ವರಲಾಭಾದಿನಾ ಪಿಪರ್ತನ । ಸ್ತೋತ್ರಾದಿನಾ
ಪ್ರೀಣಯತ । ಯಾವದಸ್ಯ ಮಾಹಾತ್ಮ್ಯಂ ಜಾನೀಥ ತಾವದಿತ್ಯರ್ಥಃ॥ ವಿದೇರ್ಲಟಿ ಮಧ್ಯಮಬಹುವಚನಂ।
ವಿದ ಋತಸ್ಯೇತ್ಯತ್ರ ಸಂಹಿತಾಯಾಮೃತ್ಯಕ ಇತಿ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಭಾವಃ ॥ ಕಿಂಚಾಸ್ಯ ಮಹಾನುಭಾವಸ್ಯ
ವಿಷ್ಣೋರ್ನಾಮ ಚಿತ್ ಸರ್ವೈರ್ನಮನೀಯಮಭಿಧಾನಂ ಸಾರ್ವಾತ್ಮಪ್ರತಿಪಾದ- ಕಂ ವಿಷ್ಣುರಿತ್ಯೇತನ್ನಾಮ ಜಾನಂತಃ ಪುರುಷಾರ್ಥಪ್ರದಮಿತ್ಯಧಿಗಚ್ಛಂತ ಆ ಸಮಂತಾದ್ವಕ್ತನ । ವದತ ।
ಸಂಕೀರ್ತಯತ । ಯದ್ವಾ । ನಾನು ಯಜ್ಞಾತ್ಮನಾ ನಮನಂ ವಿಷ್ಣೋರೇವ ಸರ್ವೇಷಾಂ ಸ್ವರ್ಗಾಪವರ್ಗಸಾಧನಾಯೇಷ್ಟಾದ್ಯಾತ್ಮನಾ ದ್ರವ್ಯದೇವತಾತ್ಮನಾ ವಾ ಪರಿಣಾಮಮಾ ಜಾನಂತೋ ಯೂಯಂ ವಿವ
ಕ್ತನ । ಬ್ರೂತ । ಸ್ತುತ ॥ ವಚೇರ್ಲೋಟಿ ಛಾಂದಸಃ ಶಪ ಶ್ಲುಃ । ಬಹುಲಂ ಛಂದಸೀತ್ಯಭ್ಯಾಸಸ್ಯೆತ್ವಂ ।
ಪೂರ್ವವತ್ತನಾದೇಶಃ ॥ ಇದಾನೀಂ ಸಾಕ್ಷಾತ್ಕೃತ್ಯಾಹ । ಹೇ ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ಸರ್ವಾತ್ಮಕ ದೇವ ಮಹೋ ಮಹತಸ್ತೇ ತವ ಸುಮತಿಂ ಸುಷ್ಟುತಿಂ ಶೋಭಾತ್ಮಿಕಾಂ ಬುದ್ಧಿಂ ವಾ ಭಜಾಮಹೇ । ಸೇವಾಮದೇ ವಯಂ

en: "O hymners, that very Viṣṇu, पूर्व्यं (*pūrvyaṃ*), ancient, beginninglessly established, the germ (गर्भं (*garbhaṃ*)) of ऋतस्य (*ṛtasya*), of the sacrifice: he is the embryo of sacrifice, that is, born in the form of sacrifice." The basis is the śruti यज्ञो वै विष्णुः (*yajño vai viṣṇuḥ*), "sacrifice is indeed Viṣṇu", Śa.

The reference is 1-1-2-13. Or else: ऋतस्य (*ṛtasya*) means "of water", and गर्भं (*garbhaṃ*) means "the cause of the germ", that is, the producer of water, on the authority of the smṛti अप एव ससर्जादौ (*apa eva sasarjādau*) (Manu 1-8). Know such a Viṣṇu and propitiate him (पिपर्तन (*pipartana*)) with hymns and the like, of your own accord (जनुषा (*januṣā*), by birth, spontaneously), not through any boon or the like; propitiate him as far as you know his greatness. विद (*vida*) is the second person plural of the present of the root *vid*; in विद ऋतस्य (*vida ṛtasya*) the Saṃhitā has the natural form (*prakṛtibhāva*).

Further, knowing the name of this greatly glorious Viṣṇu, नाम चित् (*nāma cit*), the designation to be bowed to by all, which expresses him as the self of all, namely the name "Viṣṇu", as bestowing the goals of man, proclaim (विवक्तन (*vivaktana*)) it on every side; speak, extol. Or else: knowing the bowing (नाम (*nāma*)) as the very transformation of Viṣṇu alone, in the form of sacrifice, iṣṭi and the rest, or in the form of substance and deity, for the attainment of heaven and release for all, you declare, praise. The form विवक्तन (*vivaktana*) is Vedic (the *śap* replaced by *śluḥ*, the reduplicative vowel becomes *e*, the ending *tana*). Now addressing him directly: O Viṣṇu, god who are the self of all, we sacrificers serve your great सुमतिं (*sumatiṃ*), good praise, or your beautiful understanding.

kn: ಗರ್ಭಭೂತನಾಗಿ ಯಜ್ಞಾತ್ಮಕನಾಗಿ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನನಾದವನೂ ಅಥವಾ ಉದಕೋತ್ಪಾದಕನಾದವನೂ ಆದ । ತಮು—
ಆ ವಿಷ್ಣುವನ್ನೇ । ಯಥಾ ವಿದ—ಯಾವ ಬಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀವು ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತೀರೋ ಹಾಗೆ (ಫಲಾಪೇಕ್ಷೆಯ) ಜನುಷಾ-
ಈ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ । ನಾಮ ಚಿತ್—ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಧ್ಯಾನಿಸಬೇಕಾದ “ ವಿಷ್ಣು ” ಎಂಬ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು । ಜಾನಂತಃ—(ಪುರುಷಾ
ರ್ಥಪ್ರದವೆಂದು) ತಿಳಿದವರಾಗಿ ಅಥವಾ (ಯಜ್ಞಾತ್ತನಾಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೇ ಸರ್ವವೂ ಅರ್ಪಿತವು) ಎಂದು
ತಿಳಿದವರಾಗಿ । ಆ ವಿವಕ್ತನ—(ಅವನ ಮುಖವನ್ನು) ಕೀರ್ತನಮಾಡಿ । ವಿಷ್ಣೋ—ಎಲೈ ವಿಷ್ಣವೇ ।
ಸೇವಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ । (ಅಥವಾ) ನಾವು ನಿನ್ನ ಅನುಗ್ರಹವನ್ನು ಪಡೆದು ಸುಖವಾಗಿರುವಂತಾಗಲಿ ।
en: - ऋतस्य गर्भं (*ṛtasya garbhaṃ*)—born as the embryo of sacrifice, in the form of sacrifice; or the producer of water
- यथा विद (*yathā vida*)—in whatever way you know
- जनुषा (*januṣā*)—without any expectation of reward, of your own accord
- पिपर्तन (*pipartana*)—propitiate with hymns and the like
- नाम चित् (*nāma cit*)—the name "Viṣṇu", to be meditated upon by all
- जानंतः (*jānaṃtaḥ*)—knowing it (as bestowing the goals of man), or knowing (that, since he is of the nature of sacrifice, everything is offered to him)
- भजामहे (*bhajāmahe*)—we serve; or may we obtain your grace and be happy

kn: ಎಲೈ ಸ್ತೋತೃಗಳೇ, ಅನಾದಿಸಂಸಿದ್ಧನೂ, ಯಜ್ಞಕ್ಕೆ ಗರ್ಭಭೂತನಾಗಿ ಯಜ್ಞಾತ್ಮನಾಗಿ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನನಾದ
ವನೂ, ಆದ ಆ ವಿಷ್ಣುವನ್ನೇ ನೀವು ಯಾವ ಬಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತೀರೋ ಹಾಗೆ ನೀವು ಯಾವ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲವನ್ನೂ
ಅಪೇಕ್ಷಿಸದೆ ಸ್ತೋತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ತೃಪ್ತಿಪಡಿಸಿರಿ. ಮಹಾನುಭಾವನಾದ ಈ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಧ್ಯಾನಿಸಬೇಕಾದ
ಮಹಾನಾಮವನ್ನು ಪುರುಷಾರ್ಥಪ್ರದವೆಂದು ತಿಳಿದವರಾಗಿ ಅವನ ಮಹಿಮೆಯನ್ನು ಕೀರ್ತನಮಾಡಿರಿ. ಎಲೈ ವಿಷ್ಣುವೇ
en: O hymners, that Viṣṇu, beginninglessly established, born as the embryo of sacrifice in the form of sacrifice: in whatever way you know him, propitiate him with hymns, without expecting any reward. Knowing the great name of this greatly glorious Viṣṇu, to be meditated upon by all, as bestowing the goals of man, proclaim his glory. O Viṣṇu, great-souled, may we too enjoy your favour.

kn: Hymners, propitiate of your own accord that ancient Vishnu, since you know him as the germ of sacrifice ; cognizant of his greatness, celebrate his name : may we, Vishnu, enjoy your favour.
en: Hymners, propitiate of your own accord that ancient Vishnu, since you know him as the germ of sacrifice ; cognizant of his greatness, celebrate his name : may we, Vishnu, enjoy your favour.

kn: ಈ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣಿತವಾಗಿರುವ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ಗುಣಗಳೂ ಸಹ ತೈತ್ತಿರೀಯ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣದಲ್ಲಿ (ತೈ. ಬ್ರಾ.
೨-೪-೩-೯) ಇದೇ ಆನುಪೂರ್ವಿಯಿಂದ ವರ್ಣಿತವಾಗಿವೆ. ಆದರೆ ಈ ಋಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜನುಷಾ ಪಿಪರ್ತನ ಎಂಬುದಕ್ಕೆ
ಬದಲಾಗಿ ಹವಿಷಾ ಪಿಪರ್ತನ ಎಂದೂ, ಮಹಸ್ತೇ ವಿಷ್ಣೋ ಎಂಬುದಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗಿ ಬೃಹತ್ತೇ ವಿಷ್ಣೋ
ಋತಸ್ಯ ಗರ್ಭಂ— ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ವಿಧವಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಮೊದಲನೆಯದಾಗಿ ಯಜ್ಞಸ್ಯ
ಗರ್ಭಭೂತಂ । ಯಜ್ಞಾತ್ಮನೋತ್ಪನ್ನಮಿತ್ಯರ್ಥಃ । ಯಜ್ಞೋ ವೈ ವಿಷ್ಣುರಿತಿ ಶ್ರುತೇಃ । ಯಜ್ಞವೇ
ವಿಷ್ಣುವೆಂದು ಶ್ರುತಿಯಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಅಂತಹ ಯಜ್ಞರೂಪವಾದ ಋತಕ್ಕೆ ಗರ್ಭಭೂತನೆಂದು ಒಂದರ್ಥವನ್ನೂ,
ಎರಡನೆಯದಾಗಿ, ಋತಸ್ಯ ಉದಕಸ್ಯ ಗರ್ಭಂ ಗರ್ಭಕಾರಣಂ । ಉದಕೋತ್ಪಾದಕಮಿತ್ಯರ್ಥಃ । ಅಪ
ಏವ ಸಸರ್ಜಾದಾವಿತಿ ಸ್ಮೃತೇಃ । ಋತಶಬ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಕವೆಂದೂ ಅರ್ಥವಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಉದಕಕ್ಕೆ ಗರ್ಭಕಾರಣ
ನೆಂದು ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನೂ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಋತಶಬ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಈ ಎರಡರ್ಥಗಳೂ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದಲೂ, ಈ ಎರಡು
ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳಿಗೂ ಸಹ ಶ್ರುತಿವಾಕ್ಯಗಳ ಸಮರ್ಥನೆಗಳಿರುವುದರಿಂದಲೂ ಸಹ ಈ ಎರಡರಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು
ತದ್ವಿಷ್ಣುಃ ಪ್ರಥಮಃ ಪ್ರಾಪ । ಸ ದೇವಾನಾಗ್ಂ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠೋಭವತ್ತಸ್ಮಾದಾಹುರ್ವಿಷ್ಣುರ್ದೇವಾನಾಗ್‌ಂ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಇತಿ । ಸ ಯಃ ಸ ವಿಷ್ಣುರ್ಯಜ್ಞಃ ಸ । ಸ ಯಃ ಸ ಯಜ್ಞೋಸೌ ಸ
ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಜ್ಞವೇ ವಿಷ್ಣುವೆಂದು ಯಜ್ಞಕ್ಕೂ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿಗೂ ತಾದಾತ್ಮ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿದೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ
ಆಪೋ ಹ ವಾ ಇದಮಗ್ರೇ ಸಲಿಲಮೇವಾಸ ತಾ ಅಕಾಮಯಂತ ಕಥಂ ನು ಪ್ರಜಾಯೇಮಹೀತಿ

en: The qualities of Viṣṇu described in this Ṛk are described in the same order in the Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa (Tai. Brā. 2-4-3-9). But where this Ṛk has जनुषा पिपर्तन (*januṣā pipartana*) the Brāhmaṇa has हविषा पिपर्तन (*haviṣā pipartana*), and where this Ṛk has महस्ते विष्णो (*mahaste viṣṇo*) the Brāhmaṇa has बृहत्ते विष्णो (*bṛhatte viṣṇo*); a slight change.

ऋतस्य गर्भं (*ṛtasya garbhaṃ*): he gives two explanations. First, यज्ञस्य गर्भभूतं । यज्ञात्मनोत्पन्नमित्यर्थः । यज्ञो वै विष्णुरिति श्रुतेः (*yajñasya garbhabhūtaṃ | yajñātmanotpannamityarthaḥ | yajño vai viṣṇuriti śruteḥ*). Since the śruti says that sacrifice is Viṣṇu, one meaning is that he is the embryo of the ṛta that is of the form of sacrifice. Second, ऋतस्य उदकस्य गर्भं गर्भकारणं । उदकोत्पादकमित्यर्थः । अप एव ससर्जादाविति स्मृतेः (*ṛtasya udakasya garbhaṃ garbhakāraṇaṃ | udakotpādakamityarthaḥ | apa eva sasarjādāviti smṛteḥ*). Since the word *ṛta* also means water, he gives another meaning, that Viṣṇu is the cause of the germ of water. Because the word *ṛta* has both meanings, and because both views are supported by śruti statements, either meaning fits.

In the sentences तद्विष्णुः प्रथमः प्राप । स देवानाग्ं श्रेष्ठोभवत्तस्मादाहुर्विष्णुर्देवानाग्‌ं श्रेष्ठ इति । स यः स विष्णुर्यज्ञः स । स यः स यज्ञोसौ स आदित्यः । (*tadviṣṇuḥ prathamaḥ prāpa | sa devānāgṃ śreṣṭhobhavattasmādāhurviṣṇurdevānāgṃ śreṣṭha iti | sa yaḥ sa viṣṇuryajñaḥ sa | sa yaḥ sa yajñosau sa ādityaḥ |*) (Pa. Prā. 14-1-1-4 to 5) ⟨NOTE:434⟩, यज्ञो विष्णुः प्रजापतिः (*yajño viṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ*) (Mai. Tri. 6-16) ⟨NOTE:435⟩, and त्वं यज्ञस्तं विष्णुस्तं वषट्कारः (*tvaṃ yajñastaṃ viṣṇustaṃ vaṣaṭkāraḥ*) (Tai. U. 4-25-6) ⟨NOTE:436⟩, and similar sentences, the identity of sacrifice and Viṣṇu is stated: sacrifice is Viṣṇu. By this the first meaning is supported. And in

आपो ह वा इदमग्रे सलिलमेवास ता अकामयंत कथं नु प्रजायेमहीति ता आश्राम्यंस्तास्तपोऽतप्यंत तासु तपस्तप्यमानासु हिरण्मयमांडग्ं संबभूवाजातो ह तर्हि संवत्सर आस तदिदग्ं हिरण्मयमांडं यावत्संवत्सरस्य वेला तावत्पर्यप्लवत । ततः संवत्सरे पुरुषः समभवत् । (*āpo ha vā idamagre salilamevāsa tā akāmayaṃta kathaṃ nu prajāyemahīti tā āśrāmyaṃstāstapo 'tapyaṃta tāsu tapastapyamānāsu hiraṇmayamāṃḍagṃ saṃbabhūvājāto ha tarhi saṃvatsara āsa tadidagṃ hiraṇmayamāṃḍaṃ yāvatsaṃvatsarasya velā tāvatparyaplavata | tataḥ saṃvatsare puruṣaḥ samabhavat |*) (Ta. Brā. 11-1-6-1) ⟨NOTE:437⟩
and similar sentences it is said that water was the beginning of creation and that Viṣṇu in the form of the golden germ was its support. By this the second meaning is supported.

पिपर्तन (*pipartana*): पिपर्ति पपुरिरिति प्रिणातिनिगमौ वा प्रीणाति निगमौ वा (*piparti papuririti priṇātinigamau vā prīṇāti nigamau vā*). It has been stated earlier (Ni. 5-24) that this is formed either from the root *pṛ*, which gives the sense "fill", or from the root *prī*, which gives the sense "propitiate". In the present Ṛk the meaning is "propitiate Viṣṇu with hymns and the like".

जनुषा (*januṣā*): this word means जन्ममात्रेण (*janmamātreṇa*), "from birth itself". Expanded, this meaning comes to "naturally" or "spontaneously". In the present Ṛk, जन्मना स्वत एव न केनचिद्वरलाभादिना (*janmanā svata eva na kenacidvaralābhādinā*): without expectation of any reward of any kind, with natural and pure praises, "propitiate": a prayer in the form of an injunction.

नाम चित् (*nāma cit*): सर्वैर्नमनीयमभिधानं सार्वात्मप्रतिपादकं विष्णुरित्येतन्नाम (*sarvairnamanīyamabhidhānaṃ sārvātmapratipādakaṃ viṣṇurityetannāma*): the name "Viṣṇu", to be bowed to by all, which is all-pervading and has the power of making the whole universe inwardly contained; this is one way of taking it. And the other: यद्वा नाम यज्ञात्मना नमनं विष्णोरेव सर्वेषां स्वर्गापवर्गसाधनायेष्ट्याद्यात्मना द्रव्यदेवतात्मना ना परिणाममा जानंतो वा (*yadvā nāma yajñātmanā namanaṃ viṣṇoreva sarveṣāṃ svargāpavargasādhanāyeṣṭyādyātmanā dravyadevatātmanā nā pariṇāmamā jānaṃto vā*) ⟨NOTE:438⟩. Since Viṣṇu is himself of the form of sacrifice, the iṣṭis and the like, which are the means to heaven and to release, the substances that are their parts, and the deities addressed in the sacrifice, all are only other forms of Viṣṇu. Knowing that all of them are parts of Viṣṇu, worship and propitiate Viṣṇu through them: this is the other way of explaining it.

en: - स्तोतारः — ष्टुञ् स्तुतौ धातुः । कर्तरि तृच् प्रत्ययः । संबोधनाबहुवचने गुणे प्राप्ते अप्‌तृन्‌तृच् इति उपधादीर्घः । आमंत्रितस्य च इति निघातस्वरः भवति ।
- विद — विद ज्ञाने धातुः । अदादिः । लटः मध्यमपुरुषबहुवचने थ प्रत्ययः । विदोलटो वा (पा सू. ३-४-८३) इति तस्य अ आदेशः । सार्वधातुकमपित् इति जीत्वात् लघूपधगुणः न भवति । यथा इति पूर्वं स्थितत्वात्
निघातस्वरः न भवति । प्रत्ययस्वरेण अंतोदात्तः भवति । विद+ऋतस्य इति स्थिते संहितायां ऋत्यकः इति प्रकृतिभावः भवति ।
- जनुषा — जनी प्रादुर्भावे धातुः । जनेरुसिः इति उस् प्रत्ययः । प्रत्ययस्वरेण उकारः उदात्तः भवति । तृतीया एकवचनांतरूपम् ।

- पिपर्तन — पृ पालनपूरणयोः पृ इत्येके धातुः । जुहोत्यादिः । लोट् मध्यमपुरुषबहुवचने तप्तनप्तनथनाश्च (पा सू. ७-१-४५) इति तस्य तनपादेशः । श्लौ इति धातोः द्वित्वम् । अर्तिपिपर्त्योश्च (पा. सू. ७-४-२७) इति अभ्यासस्य इत्वम् । प्रत्ययस्य पित्त्वात् जित्वाभावे धातोः इको गुणः । अतिजंतस्य परत्वात् निघातस्वरः भवति ।

- जानंतः — ज्ञा अवबोधने धातुः । अस्मात् आगतस्य लटः शत्रादेशः । श्नाविकरणे ज्ञाजनोर्जा (पा. सू. ७-३-७९) इति धातोः जादेशः । श्नाभ्यस्तयोरातः (पा. सू. ६-४-११२) इति विकरणस्य आकारस्य लोपः । प्रथमाबहुवचनांतरूपम् । प्रत्ययस्य आद्युदात्तस्वरः भवति ।

- विवक्तन — वच परिभाषणे धातुः । लोट् मध्यमपुरुषबहुवचने पूर्ववत् तनबादेशः । बहुलं छंदसि इति विकरणस्य श्लु आदेशः । श्लु इति धातोः द्वित्वे प्राप्ते बहुलं छंदसि इति अभ्यासस्य इत्वम् । चोःकुः इति धातुचकारस्य कुत्वम् । तिजंतनिघातस्वरः भवति ।
- सुमतिम् — मन ज्ञाने धातुः । क्तिन् प्रत्ययः । मंत्रेवृषेषपच (पा. सू. ३-३-९६) इति क्तिन् उदात्तः भवति । प्रादिसमासे कृदुत्तरपदप्रकृतिस्वरः भवति ।
- भजामहे — भज सेवायां धातुः । लट् उत्तमपुरुषबहुवचनांतरूपम् । तिजंतनिघातस्वरः भवति ।

ದಾಧಾರ ದಕ್ಷಮುತ್ತಮಮಹರ್ವಿದಂ ವ್ರಜಂ ಚ ವಿಷ್ಣುಃ ಸಖಿವಾ
ref: तम॑स्य॒ राजा॒ वरु॑ण॒स्तम॒श्विना॒ क्रतुं॑ सचन्त॒ मारु॑तस्य वे॒धस॑ः।

kn: ತಂ । ಅಸ್ಯ । ರಾಜಾ । ವರುಣಃ । ತಂ । ಅಶ್ವಿನಾ । ಕ್ರತುಂ । ಸಚಂತ । ಮಾರುತಸ್ಯ । ವೇಧಸಃ ।
ದಾಧಾರ । ದಕ್ಷಂ । ಉತ್ತ್ ತಮಂ । ಅಹಃವಿದಂ । ವ್ರಜಂ । ಚ । ವಿಷ್ಣುಃ । ಸಖಿವಾನ್ । ಅಪಊರ್ಣುತೇ ॥ ೪ ॥
ಅಗ್ನೀಷೋಮಪ್ರಣಯನೇ ತಮಸ್ಯ ರಾಜೇತ್ಯೇಷಾ ಪ್ರಯೋಕ್ತವ್ಯಾ । ಅಗ್ನೀಷೋಮ್ ಪ್ರಣೇಷ್ಯತ್ಸ್ವಿತಿ ಖಂಡೇ ಸೂತ್ರಿತಂ । ತಮಸ್ಯ ರಾಜಾ ವರುಣಸ್ತಮಶ್ವಿನೇತ್ಯರ್ಧರ್ಚ ಆರಮೇತ್ । ಆ. ೪-೧೦ ।
ಮಾರುತಸ್ಯ ಮರುತಾಮೃತ್ವಿಜಾಂ ಸಂಘಾತೋ ಮಾರುತಂ। ತದ್ವತಃ ॥ ಮತ್ವರ್ಥೋ ಲುಪ್ಯತೇ ॥
ಮರುತಾಂ ದೇವಾನಾಂ ಸಂಬಂಧಿನೋ ವಾ ವೇಧಸೋ ಮೇಧಾವಿನೋಽಸ್ಯ ಯಜಮಾನಸ್ಯ ತಂ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಂ
ಕ್ರತುಂ ಯಾಗಂ ಯಜ್ಞಾತ್ಮಕಂ ವಿಷ್ಣುಂ । ಯಜ್ಯೋವೈ ವಿಷ್ಣುರಿತಿ ಶ್ರುತೇಃ । ರಾಜಾ ರಾಜಮಾನೋ
ವರುಣಃ ಸಚಂತ । ಸೇವತೇ । ತಮೇವ ಕ್ರತುಂ ಯಾಗಮಶ್ವಿನಾಶ್ವಿನೌ ಸಚೇತೇ । ಅನ್ಯೇಽಪಿ ದೇವಾಃ
ಸಚಂತೇ। ಸೇವಂತೇ । ಕಿಂಚ ವಿಷ್ಣುಃ ಸವನತ್ರಯಾತ್ಮನಾ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತೋ ವಿಷ್ಣುಃ ಸಖಿವಾನ್ ಯಜಮಾನಾದಿಸಖಿಭಿರ್ಯುಕ್ತಃ ಸನ್ನುತ್ತಮಮುತ್ಕೃಷ್ಟತಮಮಹರ್ವಿದಮಹರ್ವೇತ್ತಾರಂ। ಸ್ವರ್ಗೋತ್ಪಾದಕಮಿತ್ಯರ್ಥಃ।
ದಕ್ಷಂ ಬಲಂ ಫಲಪ್ರದಾನಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯರೂಪಂ ದಾಧಾರ । ಧೃತವಾನ್ । ಕಿಂಚ ವ್ರಜಂ ಚ ಮೇಘಂ ಚ ।
ವ್ರಜ ಇತಿ ಮೇಘನಾಮ ವ್ರಜಶ್ಚರುರಿತಿ ತನ್ನಾಮಸು ಪಾತಾತ್ । ತಂ ವೃಷ್ಟುವದಕಾರ್ಯಾಪೋರ್ಣುತೇ ।

ಅಪಗತಾವರಣಂ ಕರೋತಿ । ಆಹುತಿದ್ವಾರಾ ಯಜ್ಞಸ್ಯೆವ ವೃಷ್ಟುತ್ಪಾದಕತ್ವಾತ್ । ಯದ್ವಾ । ಮಾರುತಸ್ಯ ಮರುತ್ಸಂಘಾತಸ್ಯ ದೇವಗಣಸ್ಯ ವೇಧಸೋ ವಿಧಾತುಃ ಸ್ರಷ್ಟುರ್ವಿಷ್ಣೋಃ ಕ್ರತುಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಪಾಲನಾದಿರೂಪಂ ವರುಣಾದಯಃ ಸಚಂತೇ । ತದಧೀನತ್ವಾತ್ಪಾಲನಸ್ಯ । ಸ ಚ ಸಖಿವಾನಿಂದ್ರಮರುದಾದಿ
ಸಹಾಯೋಪೇತಃ ಸನ್ನುಕ್ತಲಕ್ಷಣಂ ದಕ್ಷಂ ವೃಷ್ಟುತ್ಪಾದನಾದಿಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯರೂಪಂ ಬಲಂ ದಾಧಾರ ।

en: This Ṛk is to be employed at the Agnīṣoma-praṇayana. The sūtra is: in the section beginning "when they are about to lead forth Agni and Soma", तमस्य राजा वरुणस्तमश्विनेत्यर्धर्च आरमेत् (*tamasya rājā varuṇastamaśvinetyardharca āramet*) (Ā. 4-10).

मारुतस्य (*mārutasya*) means belonging to the Maruts, the company of priests (ṛtvij), the suffix of possession being dropped. Or it means belonging to the Maruts, the gods. वेधसः (*vedhasaḥ*) means "of the wise". The words thus describe this sacrificer. Varuṇa, shining as king, attends that well-known क्रतुं (*kratuṃ*), the sacrifice, which is Viṣṇu in the form of sacrifice, since the Śruti says *yajño vai viṣṇuḥ*. The two Aśvins attend that same sacrifice, and other gods attend it too.

Further, Viṣṇu, pervading the three pressings, accompanied by friends such as the sacrificer, bears the दक्षं (*dakṣaṃ*) that is highest, the best, and "day-finding", that is, the producer of heaven. This power is the strength of bestowing the fruit. He also uncovers the cloud: व्रज (*vraja*) is a name of the cloud, as it is among the cloud-names listed in the Nighaṇṭu. He removes its covering so that rain falls, because through the oblation the sacrifice itself produces rain.

Or else: Varuṇa and the others attend the work (क्रतुं (*kratuṃ*)), consisting of protection and the like, of Viṣṇu, the creator of the divine host of Maruts, since protection depends on him. Accompanied by helpers such as Indra and the Maruts, he bears the power described, the strength for producing rain and so on, and uncovers the cloud.

kn: ಅಸ್ಯ—ಯಜಮಾನನ । ತಂ—ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾದ । ಕ್ರತುಂ—ಯಾಗವನ್ನು ಅಥವಾ ಯಜ್ಞಾತ್ಮಕನಾದ ವಿಷ್ಣುವನ್ನು ।
ರುವ ವಿಷ್ಣುವು । ಸಖಿವಾನ್—ಯಜಮಾನಾದಿ ಮಿತ್ರರೊಡಗೂಡಿ ಅಥವಾ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನಾದಇಂದ್ರನೊಗೂಡಿ। ಉತ್ತಮಂ—ಉತ್ಕೃಷ್ಟವಾದುದೂ । ಅಹರ್ವಿದಂ—ಸ್ವರ್ಗೋತ್ಪಾದಕವಾದುದೂ ಆದ । ದಕ್ಷಂ—ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ।
ದಾಧಾರ—ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದಾನೆ । ವ್ರಜಂ ಚ—ಮೇಘವನ್ನೂ ಸಹ । ಅಪೋರ್ಣುತೇ—(ವೃಷ್ಟ್ಯರ್ಥವಾಗಿ) ಆವರಣ
en: - मारुतस्य (*mārutasya*)—of him who is joined with the company of priests
- क्रतुं (*kratuṃ*)—sacrifice, or Viṣṇu who is the sacrifice in essence
- तं (*taṃ*)—that same, or that same Viṣṇu
- विष्णुः (*viṣṇuḥ*)—Viṣṇu, who dwells also in the form of the three pressings
- सखिवान् (*sakhivān*)—joined with friends such as the sacrificer, or with his friend Indra
- अपोर्णुते (*aporṇute*)—makes (for the sake of rain) to be without covering

kn: ಋತ್ವಿಕ್ಕುಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನೊಡನೆ ಕೂಡಿದವನೂ, ಮೇಧಾವಿಯೂ ಆದ ಯಜಮಾನನ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾದ ಯಾಗ

en: The shining Varuṇa attends the well-known sacrifice of the sacrificer, who is joined with the company of priests and is wise. The Aśvin deities too attend that same sacrifice. Viṣṇu, who pervades also the form of the three pressings, together with friends such as the sacrificer, has obtained the excellent, heaven-producing power, and he makes the cloud also to be without covering for the sake of rain.

en: The royal Varuna associates (himself) with the sacrifice of the pious worshipper, assisted by the company of the priests: the Aswins (unite with it): Vishnu, with his friend (Indra), possesses supreme heaven-conferring power, and sits upon the clouds.

kn: ಅಗ್ನಿಷ್ಟೋಮಪ್ರಣಯನಕರ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ತಮಸ್ಯ ರಾಜಾ ಎಂಬ ಈ ಋಕ್ಕನ್ನು ಪಠಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದು ಆಶ್ವಲಾಯನ

ರಾಜಾ ವರುಣಃ ಸಚಂತ—ಪ್ರಕಾಶಮಾನನಾದ ವರುಣನು ಸೇವಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆಂದು ಯಜ್ಞಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ
ವರುಣನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿದೆ. ಕಾಮ್ಯರೂಪವಾದ ಪಶುಯಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ವರುಣನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಮುಖ್ಯವಾದ ಸ್ಥಾನವಿದೆ.

" Marut or Maruta in Orninary Sanskrit mean wind, and more particularly a strong wind, differing by its violent character from Vayu or Vata Nor do the hymns themselves leave us in any doubt as to the natural phenomena with which the Maruts are identified. Storms which root up the trees of the forest, lightning, thunder and showers of rain are the background from which the Maruts in their personal and dramatic character rise
before our eyes. In most of the later native dictionaries, in the ಮೇದಿನೀ, ವಿಶ್ವ, ಹೇಮಚಂದ್ರ ಅಮರ, ಅನೇಕಾರ್ಥಧ್ವನಿಮಂಜರೀ, Marut is given as a synonym of Deva, or God in general, and so is Maru in Pali.
But, while the hymns addressed to the Maruts enable us to watch the successive
stages in the development of so called deities more clearly than any other hymns, there is no
doubt one drawback, namely, the uncertainty of the etymology of Marut .... .... .... .... ....
No better etymology having been proposed, I still maintain that the derivation of Marut from
మృ to pound, to smash, is free from any objection and that the original conception of the
Maruts was that of crushing, smashing, striking, tearing, destroying storms ".
